description:
**This position is based in Germany with hybrid or remote working options. Applicants must hold a valid work/residence permit for the respective location.**

Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaosâ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chaos is a global company with offices in 11 cities worldwide. In 2022, Chaos and Enscape merged, bringing together two industry-leading companies into one. Since then, Chaos has continued to grow with the additions of Cylindo, AXYZ Design, and Evolve Lab, further expanding our expertise and solutions across architecture, design, e-commerce, and AI. For more information, please visit chaos.com.

Role Overview

The Team Lead, Education Sales leads the Education sales team and owns the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for the Education segment, covering both University and Student markets. The role is responsible for driving new institution and student customer acquisition, growing ARR within the existing base, and reducing churn across both segments. The University segment operates through direct, relationship-led sales to institutions, while the Student segment runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey, requiring close partnership with the Ecommerce team to optimise the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience. Reporting to the Sr. Director GTM Strategy & Transformation, this role requires a commercially driven sales leader with a hands-on approach, a track record of owning segment revenue end-to-end, and the ability to coach and develop a team while remaining personally active in deals. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy and suits someone who wants to build and scale a team rather than maintain one.

Main Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the Education sales team, setting clear individual performance expectations, coaching from the front, and stepping into deals directly where needed to support pipeline and attainment targets.

  • Own and scale a proactive, discovery-led outbound motion to win new institution and student customers, continuously refining outreach cadence and qualification criteria.

  • Drive expansion and retention within the existing student and institution customer base, identifying and executing initiatives that grow ARR and reduce churn.

  • Own ARR and pipeline growth within the University segment through relationship-led, direct sales to institutions, tracking key performance metrics and diagnosing and correcting underperformance.

  • Own ARR and seat growth within the Student segment, which runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey rather than a traditional sales motion; partner with the Ecommerce team to continuously optimize the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience.

  • Own accurate pipeline forecasting and attainment reporting for the Education business, providing reliable visibility into performance for sales reviews and senior leadership.

  • Partner with RevOps, Marketing, Product, and Ecommerce to ensure Education-specific campaigns, content, and product feedback are prioritised and executed effectively.



Required Experience

  • At least 5 years of sales experience within a SaaS or technology environment, including demonstrated experience leading a sales team with direct accountability for team performance and revenue outcomes.

  • Proven track record of owning a direct sales territory or segment end-to-end, from pipeline generation through closed, retained revenue.

  • Experience managing and influencing a low-touch, digital or ecommerce-led purchase journey (funnel, conversion, pricing) is a strong advantage.

  • Previous experience in Architecture, Education, EdTech, or a related vertical is an advantage, but not required.

Required Skills

  • Takes full ownership of commercial outcomes: builds pipeline, closes deals, and drives team performance without waiting to be directed.

  • Leads by example in the field: comfortable coaching team members through live deals and personally engaging in high-priority opportunities where it makes a difference.

  • Translates ARR and revenue data into clear, defensible strategy, is able to identify where performance is off track, diagnose the root cause, and act on it.

  • Communicates with credibility at senior level: presents team results, forecasts, and strategic needs clearly to VP-level and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Able to build effective working relationships and collaborate cross-functionally across Ecommerce, RevOps, and Marketing: driving digital funnel and conversion improvements for the Student segment without direct authority.

  • Operates effectively with high autonomy in a fast-moving environment: sets own priorities, creates momentum without close direction, and holds a consistently high personal bar for execution and results.

  • Familiarity with MEDDICC or a similar sales qualification framework is an advantage.

We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Solutions Delivery Manager is responsible for ensuring Benchling solution development, coverage, efficacy, quality, and enablement across the Customer Experience team. Operating at the intersection of our product suite and our customers, this dynamic role focuses on translating our product capabilities into effective solutions to match our customers' scientific use cases, and enabling the broader CX organization to operationalize around Benchling's best practices. description:
About us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Our People

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. Weâre proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Role

We are seeking a Lead Product Designer who can elevate HighLevel's product experiences through exceptional craft, product vision, systems thinking and influence. You have spent 7+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or similarly sophisticated product experiences, and are ready to shape product direction, design standards and team culture across one or more product pillars.

As a lead individual contributor, you will partner deeply with product and engineering leaders, mentor other designers and help teams define and improve strategically important product experiences across the HighLevel platform. You will connect customer needs, business goals, technical constraints and long-term product strategy to clear, useful and highly polished product design.

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate an extraordinarily high bar for design craft and visual sophistication, and to raise that bar for the teams around them. You should care deeply about hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, interaction quality, usability, accessibility and the standards that make product experiences feel refined, trustworthy and coherent at scale. We want candidates who can ship truly world-class product design.

Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is mandatory. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

What You Can Expect

  • Autonomy to shape design direction across one or more strategically important product pillars.

  • Meaningful influence with product, engineering and senior leadership on product quality, customer outcomes and roadmap direction.

  • The opportunity to raise the design bar across multiple teams through critique, standards, mentorship and systems thinking.

  • Partnership with ambitious product, engineering, data and design peers who value clarity, speed, craft and customer outcomes.

  • A craft-forward design culture where lead designers help strengthen design practice, improve team rituals and grow other designers.

  • A 100% remote environment where distributed collaboration is normal. Employees in all geographies are expected to be flexible and thoughtful about working hours so US- and India-based colleagues can collaborate effectively.

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of relevant product design experience, with 2+ years in a leadership, mentorship or design direction capacity; experience in SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or other complex digital product environments is highly valuable.

  • An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates systematic thinking, customer empathy, exceptional craft, measurable product impact and leadership beyond individual execution.

  • Proven experience leading data-informed product design across the full lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing.

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality.

  • Experience designing for AI-driven or intelligent interfaces, including collaboration with machine learning, data, automation or platform teams.

  • Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions.

  • Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers.

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft.

  • Passion for improving team operations, design standards, processes, tools, documentation and better ways for teams to work.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead design strategy and execution for one or more product pillars from discovery through delivery.

  • Translate customer needs, business goals, product strategy and technical constraints into clear experience direction and design roadmaps.

  • Partner with product and engineering leaders to define product vision, prioritize opportunities and align teams around high-quality outcomes.

  • Influence leadership decisions through customer empathy, data synthesis, product judgment, storytelling and strong design rationale.

  • Drive design quality reviews and set standards for usability, accessibility, interaction quality, visual consistency and design system alignment.

  • Raise the quality of multiple teams by mentoring designers, improving critique, strengthening shared patterns and making standards easier to adopt.

  • Define and socialize metrics for design quality and impact, such as usability signals, accessibility compliance, task success, adoption, retention or customer satisfaction.

  • Lead complex discovery and design efforts through ambiguity by synthesizing inputs, framing decisions and helping teams move with clarity.

How You Work

  • You raise the bar for craft, visual sophistication and product quality across the teams around you.

  • You move comfortably between product strategy, customer insight, systems thinking and hands-on design execution.

  • You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer.

  • You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability and genuine respect for your teammates as people.

  • You enjoy leading collaboration across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates.

  • You communicate in ways that help distributed teams work with clarity, care, trust and momentum.

  • You advocate for accessibility, inclusion and ethical design.

 

\n

Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit.

The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era.

We have one product: new physics, at scale.

Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact.

Â 

Role and Responsibilities

  • Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

  • The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on.

  • Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first.

What We're Looking For

title: Surveyor I
description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. Weâre at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

title: Why do you want this new job
description:
No matter which side of the table youâve sat during interviews, youâve probably heard this question: âWhy do you want this new job?â

In the recent past, Iâve interviewed a few candidates and heard the following answers so far:

  • Iâm not learning much on the current job after itâs been 2-4 years.
  • Iâm looking for something that offers better work-life balance.
  • Iâm not really looking for a job. The recruiters got in touch and I thought Iâd discuss.
  • Iâm looking for more challenging work.

All of the above are valid answers. I think thereâs another perfectly valid answer that candidates seldom mention probably due to the gravity of the interview room situation. Iâve interviewed over a hundred candidates across different companies and am yet to find anyone that mentions: I am not happy with my current salary and benefits compared to my skills

Back to topic of answers. So, when someone answers that they are not learning new things on the job, obviously, youâd be curios to know why and how they have tried to change things. Unfortunately, most candidates simply mention that they are doing repeat work and thereâs not much to learn doing the same thing over and over again. This is where I start feeling a little uneasy. However, I understand that itâs a true statement. If youâre in a similar situation, hereâs some suggestion: read books, and write code based on what youâve read. Then, you can tell a much convincing story that, Iâve forced myself to learn new things and hereâs some proof, but I really want to apply the newly learned skills outside the scope of the âhello worldâ skills.

About work-life balance, I totally hear you. And if your current job doesnât suit what you need out of your life, itâs a perfectly valid reason to look for new opportunities. However, make sure youâre able to clearly set the expectation with your potential employer about what work-life balance means for you. For example, if you canât work over 40 hours a week, or must work from home one-two days a week, itâs best to discuss this even before an interview starts to ensure youâre a good match with the employer.

If you showed up at in interview just because a recruiter got in touch, Iâd say introspect first. Itâs possible that on our subconcious mind you have expectations that the potential of the new job offers you something that you donât get at the current job. So, instead of a passive asnwer that the you simply acted based on the recruiterâs invite, itâs much convincing to see if you can lay down one or two things that you expect from the new job that you donât get at the current job.

About looking for more challenge, it sounds like a cliche unless you can share examples of work that is of challenging to you. May be you like the challenge of using more complicated algorithms, may be you like dealing with a lot of data, may be you like supporting production emergencies, but thereâs gotta be something that you can explicitly mention as challenging. It helps employers to understand if theyâre able to provide you with enough challenge on the job.

Finally, if youâre looking for a new job because the current job isnât paying upto the level of your skills and contributions, make sure to communicate it clearly as well. With salaries and benefits, I find it much easier to work with people that know the actual $ figure thatâll make them happy instead of beating around the bush to create confusions all around. Just be confident and tell what makes you happy. If the employer can afford it, most likely theyâll want to get you onboard as a happy employee. If they canât afford it, theyâll do their best. The key here is to be explicit about what you want and be sure and confident about it.

In a nutshell, when you walk into an interview itâs yours to lose. The potential employer is investing their time and resources and would rather have you hired than having to interview other candidates. As long as you are able to justify why you want the new job, theyâll be quite accommodating.

title: Head of Security
description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send payoutsâgift cards and moneyâto anyone, anywhere, instantly. We're trusted by 20,000+ organizations, from startups to giants like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way, to reach millions of recipients worldwide.

We're profitable and growing without outside investors. We're fully remote, with a high-documentation, low-meeting culture that leaves more time for the work that mattersâand for your life outside it. Our employee NPS sits in the high 80s.

We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire.

About The Role

You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture.

This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering, Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this.

What You'll Do

  • Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security.
  • Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation.
  • Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do.
  • Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no."
  • Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it.
  • Define when and how to staff up the security function, and hire your own team.

What You'll Bring

  • Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth.
  • Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook.
  • An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code.
  • Judgment over checklists. You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. You can hold your own in a debate about whether to open up broad data access for AI tooling.
  • Bedside manner. You drive hard change by bringing the team around to your point of view, rather than just telling them no. Engineers and the rest of the company want to work with you.
  • Experience building or co-building a small security team is a plus.
  • Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry experience is a plus.

What's Cool About The Role

  • You define the function. First security leader, with the budget for the required tools and team.
  • A real mandate. The push for this hire comes straight from the founders.
  • We invest in your tools. Everyone has a $5k/month budget for AI tools. Use it.
  • Competitive pay and equity. Base salary $250,000â$330,000, plus meaningful equity.
  • Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.
  • Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do
  • Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
  • Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
  • Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
  • Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
  • Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
  • Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.

  • A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.

 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

  • Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.

title: Head of Growth (all genders) B2B SaaS für KMU
description:
Deutschland lebt von seinen kleinen und mittleren Unternehmen, und viel zu viel von deren Geld und Aufmerksamkeit geht in die Pflicht: Buchhaltung, Umsatzsteuervoranmeldung, Jahresabschluss. Unvermeidbare Arbeit, die niemand will und für die alle zu viel bezahlen.

mika nimmt sie ihnen ab. Weil nichts davon optional ist, verstehen wir das, was wir bauen, als Infrastruktur und nicht als Software, und der Zweck ist einfach: Es soll billiger werden, in Deutschland ein Unternehmen zu führen.

Von 100 auf über 700 Kund:innen in acht Monaten, und immer noch ein kleines Team. Deshalb sind diese Rollen bewusst breit: Du verantwortest einen ganzen Bereich und nicht einen Ausschnitt davon, es gibt mehr zu bauen als Menschen, die bauen, und der Bereich wächst so schnell, wie du wächst. Intern arbeiten wir auf Englisch, weil das Team international ist. Der Markt ist deutsch.

Aufgaben

Du verantwortest die Neukunden-Pipeline und die gesamte Go-to-Market-Engine und berichtest direkt an den CEO. Wenn wir ins Gespräch kommen, konvertieren wir gut. Wir erzeugen nur nicht genug Gespräche. Das ist die Zahl, die dir gehört.

Diese Rolle ist gleichzeitig die seniorste und die operativste im Growth-Bereich. Du führst heute ein kleines Team und in einem Jahr ein echtes – und lieferst die ganze Zeit über selbst ab.

Parallel besetzen wir eine Vertriebsleitung. Growth verantwortet das Go-to-Market end to end; wie die Vertriebsleitung dazu steht, gestalten wir mit der Person, die zuerst an Bord ist.

Was du machst

  • Du verantwortest Pipeline-Generierung als wichtigste Zahl des Unternehmens – end to end, nicht kanalweise
  • Du skalierst Paid Acquisition um ein Vielfaches und hältst dabei den CAC-Payback unter drei Monaten – und entscheidest, wann wir das inhouse holen
  • Du verantwortest Positionierung und Category Creation. mika ist die Finanz- und Steuerabteilung für Unternehmen, die zu klein für eine eigene sind – nie eine Buchhaltungssoftware
  • Du machst aus Partnerschaften einen messbaren Kanal und entwickelst unsere Kundenbasis zu einer Community
  • Du verantwortest neben der Demand- auch die Sales-Engine: Lane-Definition, Rep Economics, Win Rate, Cycle Time und ACV
  • Du baust und führst das Team – du entscheidest, welche Rolle wann kommt, und stellst sie selbst ein

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst

  • AI-native, nicht AI-curious. Claude oder Vergleichbares ist dein täglicher Sparringspartner, kein Tool, das du gelegentlich öffnest.
  • Du hebst deinen eigenen Output damit und automatisierst die Teile deines Jobs, für die es keinen Menschen brauchen sollte. In dieser Rolle heißt das: die Analysen und Reportings, auf die du sonst warten müsstest – und denselben Anspruch an alle, die du einstellst.
  • Du hast ein Unternehmen von rund 1 Mio. auf über 10 Mio. ARR gebracht – oder in einer früheren Rolle das erreicht, was wir uns für die nächsten 365 Tage vornehmen.
  • Output vor Planung. Du wirst daran gemessen, was jede Woche live geht, nicht an Decks. Der Fehler, den wir nicht wiederholen: starke Analysen, aus denen nie ausgelieferte Arbeit wird.
  • Du hast Paid in den sechsstelligen Monatsbereich skaliert und eine Content-Engine aufgebaut – und kannst Assets zeigen, die du selbst produziert oder direkt verantwortet hast
  • Du skalierst von zwei auf zehn Leute, ohne die zehn zum Start zu brauchen
  • First Principles und quantitativ. Du modellierst den Funnel, planst Quartale im Voraus und benennst die Metriken, an denen du gemessen werden willst, ohne dass man dich fragt.Selbststeuernd.
  • Du siehst das Problem, bevor wir es ansprechen – und handelst.
  • Geschmack. Du kannst beurteilen, ob ein Creative einem Premium-Anspruch genügt. Marke ist unser Distributions-Moat, und Qualität lässt sich nicht an Juniors delegieren.
  • Belastbar in direkter Kommunikation. Du arbeitest mit drei meinungsstarken, operativen Foundern und gibst und nimmst klares Feedback ohne Drama.

nice to have

  • Deutsche KMU-Zielgruppe, Fintech oder eine andere regulierte Kategorie
  • Category Creation dort, wo es kein Suchvolumen gab
  • Community-Aufbau
  • Du hast schon ein kleines Growth-Team eingestellt und geführt

kein Fit

  • Du brauchst ein großes Team oder gewachsene Strukturen, bevor du lieferst
  • Du führst über Strategie-Decks, wartest auf Briefings oder steuerst vor allem Agenturen
  • Du hast keinen eigenen Output vorzuweisen und keine Meinung zu unserem Funnel im ersten Gespräch

Deutsch auf C1-Niveau oder höher ist Voraussetzung. Unsere Zielgruppe, unsere Inhalte und unsere Sales-Gespräche sind deutsch – und du verantwortest die Sprache, die mika spricht. Englisch auf B2-Niveau oder höher, da Englisch unsere Teamsprache ist.

Benefits

Grundgehalt 80.000 bis 130.000 EUR je nach Erfahrung, dazu ein variabler Anteil. Er hängt am Anfang stärker an dem, was du selbst abschließt, und verschiebt sich mit dem wachsenden Team in Richtung Teamleistung.

Drei Runden: ein erstes Kennenlernen, eine Arbeitssession mit einem kurzen Case und eine letzte Runde mit den Gründern. Für eine Rolle auf diesem Level kommt ein viertes Gespräch mit einem unserer Investoren oder Mentoren dazu. Ein Termin findet in Berlin persönlich statt, und du hörst in jeder Stufe innerhalb einer Woche von uns, auch wenn die Antwort nein ist.

Warum mika?

  • Kein Budgetdeckel. Die Einmalaufträge, die Kund:innen mitbringen, decken die Akquise am ersten Tag. Solange der CAC hält, gibst du aus, was du brauchst.
  • Die Rolle trägt die wichtigste Zahl des Unternehmens – mit den passenden Befugnissen
  • Direkter Draht zu den Foundern und ein Platz bei jeder Entscheidung, die Growth berührt
  • Eine Kategorie zum Aufbauen statt eines Marktanteils zum Verteidigen
  • De facto C-Level. Für die richtige Person kann die Rolle den CMO-Titel tragen
  • Berlin, keine festen Bürotage. Komm so oft, wie es braucht, um dein Team zu führen – das entscheidest du

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf, die Zahlen, die du bewegt hast, und wie – plus eine Sache, die du an unserem Funnel ändern würdest, nachdem du zwanzig Minuten daraufgeschaut hast.

Bei mika schätzen wir Vielfalt und arbeiten an einem Umfeld, in dem alle im Team ihr Bestes geben können. Bau mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen für kleine Unternehmen.

title: Mechanical Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
About TACTILIA

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the electronics, actuators, and embedded systems that make that possible.

You will join at the moment when the hard engineering questions become real product decisions: how do we make a highly capable robotic hand reliable, manufacturable, serviceable, and simple enough to deploy on a real shop floor?

The Role

You design the mechanics of our robotic hands — from the kinematics of a single finger to a complete hand ready for series production.

Multiple drives, gear trains, tendons, tactile sensors and electronics have to fit into a human-sized envelope while surviving hundreds of thousands of cycles. Every millimetre matters, and almost every design decision affects another discipline.

You work hands-on between CAD, test rig and workshop, and report to the CTO.

What you will do:

  • CAD design. Design components, mechanisms and assemblies within tightly constrained envelopes, owning the design from concept through production release.

  • Mechanism & kinematics. Design finger and thumb kinematics, tendon and spindle drives, joints and bearings. Calculate motion envelopes, trajectories, gripping forces and transmission ratios.

  • Calculation & validation. Validate designs through structural and fatigue calculations, FEA, tolerance stack-ups and GD&T before parts are manufactured.

  • Material selection. Select and qualify materials for lightweight structures, wear surfaces, tendons and elastomeric gripping surfaces, and characterise their behaviour under real loads and contact conditions.

  • Assembly design. Design assemblies for efficient assembly, adjustment-free interfaces, serviceability and repair. Specify the required fixtures and tooling.

  • Design for manufacturing. Design for the intended manufacturing process from the outset — machining, injection moulding, sheet metal, additive manufacturing — balancing cost, tolerances and production volumes.

  • Prototyping & testing. Build prototypes, design test rigs and endurance setups, run cycle and load tests, and drive failures to root cause.

  • Documentation & release. Create drawings and BOMs, manage design changes and configuration, and support product development reviews.

  • Suppliers & production. Work with machine shops, material suppliers and manufacturing partners from first prototype through pilot series and production ramp-up.

  • Cross-functional integration. Work closely with Electronics, Sensors and Software to align packaging, interfaces and load paths across the complete system.

What you bring:

  • Degree in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, precision engineering, or a comparable qualification.

  • 5–10 years of experience in mechanical design of precision mechatronic products, including at least one product taken through to series production.

  • Advanced 3D CAD skills in CATIA, NX, SolidWorks, Creo or comparable systems, with confident 2D drawing creation and GD&T.

  • Strong understanding of mechanism design: linkages, gear trains, bearings, shafts, power transmission, backlash and stiffness.

  • Experience with FEA, structural and fatigue analysis, and tolerance calculations as part of everyday design work.

  • Strong knowledge of material selection for lightweight, high-load and wear-critical components.

  • Practical DFM/DFA experience across multiple manufacturing processes.

  • Hands-on mentality — you build the prototype, run the test and analyse the broken part yourself.

  • Fluent in English and German.

Bonus:

  • Experience with robotic hands, grippers, prosthetics or similarly highly integrated mechanisms.

  • Experience with compact drive trains, including planetary, harmonic or cycloidal gearing, spindle drives and actuator integration.

  • Experience with elastomers, soft goods, injection moulding of complex geometries or compliant structures.

  • Experience integrating tactile or force sensors into mechanical structures.

  • Experience with multi-body simulation or topology optimisation.

  • Knowledge of Machinery Regulation, ISO/TS 15066 and mechanical design for collaborative applications.

The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world.

At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability and robustness to interact with the physical world at industrial scale.

The technology is taking shape, the team is being built, and the standards around robotic hands and their skills are still open. That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI.

Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next.

If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that works reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

We serve billions of requests every week, and you've probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We're approximately doubling year over year despite the market slowing down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical. We're a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things.

Job Summary We're looking for a systems-minded, AI-native Staff Product Manager to help lead the next chapter of Constructor: Agentic Discovery. As commerce shifts toward agentic experiences, we're investing heavily in a portfolio of AI-powered surfaces — our AI Shopping Assistant, Product Insights Agent, Prism recommendations, and more to come — that change how shoppers discover products and how businesses run discovery.

This is a high-leverage, high-ambiguity role. You'll own two things at once: helping our agentic experiences scale from promising experiments into a repeatable, reliable engine, and giving the business teams who depend on them the same transparency and control over agentic experiences that they have today over traditional search.

You'll start by owning the business tooling and dashboards for agentic discovery — the experiences that let business teams see what our agents are doing, why, and to what effect, so they can execute faster and steer with confidence. Over time, your mandate grows to setting direction for the entire Agentic Discovery chapter: the on-site agentic experiences, the offsite/agentic surfaces, the integrations that connect them, and the agentic tooling underneath. This is a Staff role today with a clear path to Director as you take on chapter-wide leadership.

Agentic discovery at Constructor is fundamentally an AI and machine learning problem, so this role lives and breathes it. You'll partner closely with ML, engineering, design, and go-to-market to turn new agentic capabilities into experiences that ship, prove value, and stay under our customers' control — and serve as the connective tissue that aligns multiple teams behind one coherent vision for agentic discovery.

If you're excited about defining a brand-new category, being held to real usage and business outcomes, and giving businesses control over the AI experiences shaping their storefronts, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

  • Own business impact, not features. Drive measurable lift in usage and business outcomes — conversion, revenue, engagement — across Constructor's agentic experiences.

  • Give businesses transparency and control. Build the dashboards and tooling that let business teams see what agentic experiences are doing, understand why, and steer them — closing the gap to the control they have in traditional search.

  • Scale experimentation. Turn one-off agentic experiments into a repeatable, scalable way to launch, measure, and improve new agentic interfaces — cutting time-to-launch.

  • Set chapter vision and strategy. Define the multi-quarter direction for Agentic Discovery — where we're heading and why — tie it to customer business outcomes, and rally teams behind it.

  • Lead the business-tooling and dashboard experience first. Own its strategy and roadmap, and make agentic behavior and impact visible and actionable for business users.

     

  • Orchestrate across surfaces. Unite on-site agentic experiences, offsite/agentic surfaces, and integrations behind one definition of agentic discovery success, so improvements compound instead of colliding.

     

  • Turn AI capability into shipped experiences. Partner with ML and engineering to take agentic and LLM-powered experiences from idea to production, balancing quality, latency, cost, and reliability.

     

  • Make success measurable. Define and instrument the metrics — go-live velocity, usage, engagement, business outcomes — that tell us whether agentic discovery is working.

title: IT Change Manager (w/m/d) - Software Rollout & Digitalisierung
description:
Du möchtest digitale Veränderungen verständlich machen, Gesellschaften bei IT- und Software-Rollouts begleiten und dafür sorgen, dass neue Systeme im Arbeitsalltag wirklich ankommen? Dann suchen wir genau Dich, zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als:

IT Change Manager (w/m/d) - Software Rollout & Digitalisierung

Als IT Change Manager (w/m/d) - Software Rollout & Digitalisierung begleitest Du unsere Tochtergesellschaften bei der Einführung neuer IT-Standards, digitaler Lösungen und Softwareanwendungen - von Microsoft 365, Outlook, MFA und neuen Endgeräten bis hin zu unserer eigenen Softwareplattform GiniSuite. Die Arsipa Gruppe ist eine schnell wachsende Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich Health, Safety & Environment, unterstützt von Warburg Pincus. Mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden, 20+ Tochtergesellschaften und 90 Standorten in Deutschland und Österreich bauen wir im Rahmen einer klaren Buy-&-Build-Strategie eine skalierbare Plattform mit nachhaltiger Wertschöpfung. Unser Ziel: eine der führenden Anbieterinnen im deutschsprachigen Markt - unterstützt durch zentrale Funktionen wie Finance, People, Marketing und IT am Standort Berlin.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Change-Kommunikation & Enablement

    • Zielgruppengerechte Kommunikation für anstehende IT- und Software-Rollouts entwickelst Du für unsere Tochtergesellschaften.

    • Technische Veränderungen übersetzt Du verständlich und vermittelst, was sich verändert und welche Unterstützung zur Verfügung steht.

  • Rollout-Vorbereitung & Umsetzung

    • Unsere Tochtergesellschaften bereitest Du strukturiert auf anstehende IT- und Software-Rollouts vor.

    • Organisatorische Vorbereitungsthemen wie Zugänge, Hardware, Daten, Field Mapping, Trainings und lokale Kommunikation koordinierst Du.

    • Go-lives und Hypercare-Phasen begleitest Du mit Blick auf Akzeptanz, Nutzung und offene Fragestellungen.

    • Feedback aus den Gesellschaften nimmst Du auf und stimmst notwendige Verbesserungen mit dem Group IT Team ab.

  • Schnittstellenmanagement & Standardisierung

    • Eng arbeitest Du mit Geschäftsführungen, Führungskräften, Key Usern und operativen Teams unserer Tochtergesellschaften zusammen.

    • Technische Anforderungen übersetzt Du in konkrete und umsetzbare Maßnahmen für den Arbeitsalltag.

    • Lokale Key-User- und Multiplikatoren-Netzwerke baust Du auf und entwickelst diese kontinuierlich weiter.

    • Erfahrungen aus bisherigen Rollouts überführst Du in wiederverwendbare Standards, Methoden und Playbooks.

  • Das bringst Du mit:

    • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Change Management, Rollout Management, Projektmanagement oder in der digitalen Transformation bildet Deine fachliche Grundlage.

    • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie eine strukturierte, pragmatische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise runden Dein Profil ab.

  • Das hilft Dir, schneller erfolgreich zu sein:

Dein Profil

Was wir bieten

  • Hybrides Arbeiten mit echtem Spielraum: Top Equipment inklusive. Idealerweise bist du 2–3 Tage pro Woche bei uns im Office, aber wenn mal eine ganze Woche remote passt, ist das kein Problem.

  • Ein Team, das sich freut, dich kennenzulernen: Offene Kultur, ehrliche Kommunikation, keine Ellenbogen.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
What's it all about?

The balance of power in the energy industry needs to change. The intermittency of renewable supply and the constant demands of the grid mean that we still rely on less efficient, more expensive and unsustainable fossil fuels to keep the lights on. At Gridfuse, our mission is to shift this balance through technology. To shift the balance of inputs, so that renewables become the world's main source of electricity.  

At Gridfuse, we develop the software that controls real renewable energy assets and turns them into a coordinated Virtual Power Plant (VPP) that can respond intelligently to energy markets and grid conditions.


Your impact

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build the systems that connects our platform to these assets and turn energy-market and grid requirements into real-world actions. Your code will influence when batteries charge or discharge, how renewable assets respond, and how reliably these assets can participate in the electricity system. 

You will own and evolve core parts of the Control services, working closely with other software engineers and our renewable-energy experts.


The role

  • Design and build distributed control systems that coordinate fleets of batteries, wind turbines and solar plants 
  • Translate complex energy-market and grid requirements into reliable software behaviour 
  • Build the services responsible for communicating with physical assets and processing their telemetry, status and capabilities 
  • Design systems that continue to behave predictably when devices fail, networks are unreliable, messages arrive late or assets become temporarily unavailable
  • Build highly observable and resilient services that operate continuously in production
  • Take your services from architecture and implementation through deployment, monitoring and operation 
  • Work closely with energy-market specialists to understand the problem and turn it into pragmatic technical solutions 
  • Make architectural and technical decisions that balance reliability, scalability, simplicity and delivery speed 
  • Mentor other engineers and raise the technical bar across the team 


What we need from you

  • You are a self-starter who enjoys working in a fast-paced startup environment
  • You have several years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production backend systems
  • You have experience designing and architecting distributed systems
  • You have a “you build it, you run it” mindset and are familiar with Linux, Docker and Kubernetes
  • You have strong backend experience with Go or another modern programming language (We primarily use Go, but prior Go experience is not required)
  • Experience with asynchronous / event-driven systems. Experience with NATS, Kafka, RabbitMQ or MQTT is a plus
  • Solid understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases; experience with InfluxDB or Timescale is a plus
  • You communicate clearly and confidently in English


What we offer

  • Competitive hardware including a standing desk, 4K curved screen, and MacBook Pro  
  • City center office location including home office option  
  • EGYM Wellpass membership support 
  • Educational budget for every employee

  • Real startup culture by having an impact in a small, motivated team

The opportunity to build GTM infrastructure and directly collaborate with our founders and GTM leadership.

A beautiful office in Berlin and a team that values working together in person.

MacBook and everything else you need to do your best work.

autarc is building the AI operating system for energy installers.

title: Working Student (all genders) – Robust Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction for Dynamic Scene
description:
Abstract

Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models can recover scene geometry directly from images or videos without costly scene-specific optimization. By combining large-scale pre-training, multi-view reasoning, and strong geometric priors, these models provide an efficient alternative to traditional reconstruction pipelines such as Structure-from-Motion, NeRF, and optimization-based 3D Gaussian Splatting.

Despite recent progress, current models remain sensitive to challenging real-world conditions. Occlusions, moving objects, illumination changes, nighttime scenes, reflections, rain, fog, and snow can result in incomplete geometry, unreliable correspondences, and temporally inconsistent predictions. Improving robustness under such conditions is essential for autonomous driving and robotic perception.

As a working student, you will support the development of robust feed-forward reconstruction models for dynamic scenes.   • Evaluate and improve model performance under adverse weather conditions such as rain, fog, snow, and reduced visibility.
  • Compare the developed methods with relevant baselines and document technical and experimental results.


That makes you stand out

  • You are currently pursuing a degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, robotics, electrical engineering, data science, or a related field.
  • You have excellent programming skills in Python as well as hands-on experience with PyTorch.
  • You have a good understanding of computer vision, deep learning, 3D geometry, or multi-view vision.
  • Experience with depth estimation, optical flow, point clouds, camera pose estimation, NeRF, 3D Gaussian Splatting, or 3D reconstruction is highly beneficial.
  • Your language skills enable you to perform your role in English (at least C1 level). Knowledge of German is desirable but not required.

title: Director Sales Engineering (f/m/x)
description:
Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO

LiveEO transforms Earth Observation data and AI into actionable intelligence for critical infrastructure and supply-chain operators around the world. Our platforms Treeline, SurfaceScout, and TradeAware, help utilities, energy companies, rail operators, and global supply chains monitor vegetation risk, third-party interference, ground changes, and deforestation exposure across millions of kilometers of assets and supply chains, from space.

We're hiring our first Sales Engineering team lead to build and lead a truly global Sales Engineering organization, unifying our regional SE teams across North America, EMEA, and APAC into one consistent, high-performing technical sales function. This is a player-leader role for someone who has run distributed technical teams before, speaks fluently in geospatial and remote-sensing technology, has sold software-enabled services rather than pure-play SaaS, and has embedded MEDDPICC and value-selling discipline into a sales engine at scale.

As Director Sales Engineering (f/m/x), you will own the strategy, people, and technical rigor behind LiveEO's global pre-sales motion. You'll lead a team of regional Sales Engineers, act as the company's most senior technical voice with enterprise customers, and be the standard-bearer for how LiveEO qualifies, quantifies, and wins deals. You'll partner closely with the VP Pre-Sales & Professional Services, VP Sales, CRO, and Product leadership to make sure every region sells with the same technical credibility, the same value discipline, and the same customer-first mindset.


Your challenge

1. Global Team Leadership

  • Build, lead, and scale an international Sales Engineering team across North America, EMEA, and APAC; own hiring, onboarding, coaching, and career development for regional SEs and SE managers.

  • Set global SE strategy, headcount plan, and capacity model aligned to pipeline coverage and quota targets.

  • Establish consistent standards, certification, and career pathing so SEs anywhere in the world operate at the same bar.

  • Foster a culture of technical excellence, customer obsession, and collaborative deal support across regions and time zones.

2. Geospatial & Technical Depth

  • Serve as the most senior technical authority in the sales organization on Earth Observation, remote sensing, GIS, and satellite analytics, and translate that expertise into customer-facing value.

  • Own the technical narrative for complex RFPs/RFIs, enterprise architecture discussions, and system integrations (GIS, EAM, ERP, SCADA/OMS/DMS).

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to represent field and customer technical requirements back into the roadmap.

  • Personally engage on the company's largest, most technically complex, or highest-visibility opportunities, including large enterprise accounts.

3. MEDDPICC & Value Selling

  • Embed and continuously improve MEDDPICC qualification discipline across the global SE team, in lockstep with Sales leadership.

  • Own the SE contribution to the Value Framework, Deal Sheets, ROI modeling, and Champion Building processes; make quantified business cases the default, not the exception.

  • Coach SEs and AEs on champions, economic buyer engagement, decision-criteria influence, and competitive positioning.

  • Track and report qualification quality and value-selling maturity as a leading indicator of pipeline health.

4. Customer Advocacy

  • Act as the voice of the customer inside LiveEO — ensuring product, delivery, and pricing decisions reflect real technical and operational realities in the field.

  • Build senior technical relationships with strategic accounts and act as an executive technical sponsor on flagship and expansion deals.

  • Champion customer success stories and reference-ability back into sales and marketing.

5. Cross-Functional & Executive Leadership

  • Partner with the VP Pre-Sales & Professional Services, VP Sales, CRO, RevOps, Product, and Customer Success on GTM strategy, forecasting, and territory/resourcing planning for the global SE function.

  • Partner with the Directors of product to provide field feedback to help drive the product roadmap forward.

  • Represent Sales Engineering in executive and board-level reporting on pipeline quality, win rates, and technical risk.

  • Own SE playbooks, demo environments, and enablement content in partnership with RevOps and Product Marketing.


Your profile

  • 8+ years in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or technical pre-sales, including 4+ years leading distributed/global teams across multiple regions and time zones.

  • Enterprise experience, a demonstrated track record selling to and supporting complex enterprise accounts with multiple stakeholders and long, technical sales cycles.

  • Strong working knowledge of geospatial and remote sensing technologies, satellite/Earth Observation imagery, GIS, spatial analytics with the ability to speak credibly to technical buyers.

  • Experience with software-enabled services business models.

  • Demonstrated track record embedding MEDDPICC (or a comparable qualification framework) and quantitative value-selling/ROI methodology across a sales organization.

  • Proven customer advocacy, building trusted relationships with senior technical and business stakeholders at enterprise accounts.

  • Strong executive communication skills; comfortable operating with CRO/VP-level leadership and in board-level reporting.

  • Experience recruiting, coaching, and developing Sales Engineers and/or SE managers.

  • Experience scaling a pre-sales organization inside a high-growth (Series B/C) startup.

  • Willingness to travel globally (~30–40%).

  • Based in or near a LiveEO hub (Germany, UK, or US).

  • Experience selling SaaS/AI/analytics solutions into utilities, energy, oil & gas/midstream, rail, or supply chain/EUDR-compliance markets is a plus.

  • Familiarity with enterprise system integrations (EAM, ERP, SCADA/OMS/DMS, mobile workforce management) is a plus.

  • Familiar with product driven and tech enables services engineering organizations is a plus.


Your Benefits

  • The opportunity to create a product that can improve business processes and lives across the globe.

  • Flexible working hours and hybrid work model - we trust our employees to get their work done while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

  • We empower employees to drive their own career development, take initiative and have the freedom to be creative and bold.

  • Not an overtime culture - we take care that overtime is done only as a necessity and always offset with time off and rest.

  • A collaborative and learning environment - frequent internal workshops, knowledge sharing sessions, journal clubs and hackathons.

  • Office located in the centre of Berlin Kreuzberg with free fruit, nuts and drinks.

  • A diverse and vibrant international environment of 30+ different nationalities.

  • Potential to participate in the employee stock option program.

  • Urban Sports membership and BVG subsidy, corporate pension program.

title: Senior Consultant Search, Content & AI Visibility (SEO/GEO) (m/w/d), München
description:
Wofür wir stehen:

“We drive digital transformation end-to-end - from strategy to execution. Creating measurable progress and real impact for our clients.”
 
Stillstand? Nicht mit uns. Wir glauben: Alles ist BETA und genau darin liegt die Chance für Fortschritt. Darum hinterfragen wir Bestehendes, wagen Neues und gestalten die digitale Transformation unserer Kunden aktiv mit.
Was uns auszeichnet? Wir denken ganzheitlich. Von der strategischen Beratung bis zur Implementierung begleiten wir unsere Kunden End-to-End – mit Kreativität, technologischer Exzellenz und einem tiefen Verständnis für ihre Geschäftsmodelle. So entstehen messbarer Fortschritt und nachhaltiger Impact.
 
Und jetzt kommst du: Wir suchen Menschen mit Neugier, Ambition und dem Mut, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Menschen, die Lust haben, Neues zu lernen, unsere Kunden zu begeistern und gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen.


Deine Aufgaben:

Deine Mission: Suche hat sich in zwei Jahren mehr verändert als in den zehn davor. Unsere Kunden, B2B Hidden Champions aus Manufacturing, Industrial Goods und Wholesale, 300 Mio. bis 5 Mrd. EUR Umsatz, merken das gerade: organischer Traffic bricht ein, obwohl die Rankings stabil sind. Recherchen beginnen immer häufiger auch in ChatGPT, Perplexity und Google AI Mode statt ausschließlich auf der Suchergebnisseite. Du machst diese Marken in klassischer Suche und in generativen Systemen sichtbar. Der Hebel dafür ist Content: Sichtbarkeit entsteht heute über Inhalte, die Suchintention treffen und zitierfähig sind, nicht über Keyword-Dichte. Du gibst die inhaltliche Richtung vor und sorgst dafür, dass die Sichtbarkeit belegbar ist, nicht behauptet.

  • Strategie über die gesamte Suchlandschaft: Du entwickelst Search- und Content-Strategien, die klassisches SEO und GEO/AI Search zusammenführen, statt sie als zwei Projekte zu behandeln. Du priorisierst nach Impact, nicht nach Vollständigkeit.
  • Technisches SEO in der Tiefe: Crawling, Indexierung, Core Web Vitals, JS-Rendering, Logfile-Analyse, internes Verlinkungs- und Informationsdesign. Du begleitest Relaunches und Migrationen so, dass danach nicht die Sichtbarkeit fehlt.
  • Content-Strategie und Entitätsarchitektur: Du entwickelst Themen-, Content- und Entitätsarchitekturen entlang der B2B Buying Journey von Awareness-Content für die frühe Recherche bis zu Deep-Content, aus dem LLMs zitieren. Du entscheidest, welche Themen besetzt werden, welche Formate es braucht und was bestehender Content leisten muss.
  • Content steuern, nicht schreiben: Du briefst unser Content-Team und die Fachexpert:innen unserer Kunden, reviewst gegen Suchintention und Zitierfähigkeit und entscheidest, was publiziert wird. Du baust Content-Audits, findest Kannibalisierung und Substanzlücken und leitest daraus einen Redaktionsplan ab, der auch in sechs Monaten noch trägt. Die Texte schreiben andere. Die Richtung gibst du.
  • AI Visibility aufbauen: Du arbeitest an konsistenter Entitätsdarstellung (strukturierte Daten, sameAs, Wikidata, Branchenverzeichnisse), an zitierfähigen Inhalten und an Präsenz in den Quellen, aus denen LLMs tatsächlich zitieren.
  • AI Visibility messbar machen: Prompt-Set-basierter Share of Voice über ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot und Google AI Mode – inklusive Auswertung von GPTBot-, OAI-SearchBot- und PerplexityBot-Zugriffen in den Logfiles. Referral-Traffic aus generativen Quellen trennst du so weit, wie die Datenlage es zulässt, und dokumentierst die Grenzen der Messung offen.
  • Audits mit Konsequenz: Du führst SEO- und GEO-Audits durch, analysierst Wettbewerb und Suchintentionen und leitest daraus priorisierte Maßnahmen ab, die jemand am Montag anfangen kann.
  • Verantwortung im Retainer: Du steuerst mehrere Kundenaccounts parallel, arbeitest in vereinbarten Stundenbudgets, führst die monatlichen Reporting-Calls und Quarterly Reviews und flaggst Scope-Themen früh statt spät.
  • Beratung auf Augenhöhe: Du präsentierst auf Management-Level, bist Sparringspartner:in für Marketing- und Digital-Verantwortliche und sagst auch die unbequeme Wahrheit, wenn die Lieblings-KPI nichts über das Geschäft aussagt.
  • Neugeschäft mitgestalten: Du unterstützt bei Pitches und Angeboten, schätzt Aufwände realistisch ein und bringst dein Fachthema in Kundengespräche ein, bevor das Projekt startet.
  • AI-native im eigenen Handwerk: Du nutzt LLMs und Automatisierung für Analyse, Content-Optimierung und Reporting – und weißt, wo AI-Output eine fachliche Prüfung braucht.
  • Wissen weitergeben: Du coachst Kolleg:innen und Kunden, arbeitest eng mit Content, Performance und mit deinem Analytics-Pendant zusammen und dokumentierst so, dass Setups auch nach einer Übergabe noch tragen.


Damit kannst Du punkten:

  • Erfahrung mit Substanz: Mindestens 5 Jahre in SEO – mit echter Projektverantwortung, nicht nur Zuliefern. Du hast Setups gebaut, die noch tragen, nachdem du das Projekt abgegeben hast.
  • Technisches SEO ist dein Zuhause: Du kannst ein Setup mit fünfstelliger URL-Zahl auditieren und die Findings priorisieren. Search Console inkl. API ist dein Tagestool, dazu Screaming Frog, Logfiles und eine der gängigen Suites (Sistrix, Semrush oder Ahrefs).
  • Content-Kompetenz auf Steuerungsebene: Du hast Content-Strategien für erklärungsbedürftige B2B-Themen verantwortet, inklusive Themenarchitektur, Redaktionsplanung und Qualitätssicherung. Du schreibst Briefings, die ein Redakteur versteht, reviewst Texte gegen Suchintention und Zitierfähigkeit und erkennst, wann ein Text fachlich zu dünn ist, um in generativen Antworten zu bestehen. Selbst schreiben musst du nicht.
  • GEO-Erfahrung oder GEO-Neugier: Du hast schon an AI-Sichtbarkeit gearbeitet – oder du hast dich so ernsthaft eingelesen und ausprobiert, dass du eine fundierte Meinung dazu hast. Zum Beispiel dazu, ob llms.txt überschätzt ist. Wir erwarten keine fünf Jahre Erfahrung in einer Disziplin, die es seit zwei Jahren gibt.
  • Datenkompetenz, ohne Analytics-Rolle: Du liest GA4 und Search Console sicher, kannst mit BigQuery-Exports arbeiten und formulierst, welche Messung du brauchst. Bauen muss sie ein anderer – aber du weißt, was du bestellst.
  • B2B-Verständnis: Du weißt, dass eine 9-monatige Buying Journey mit sechs Beteiligten andere Antworten braucht als ein D2C-Shop. Projekterfahrung in Manufacturing, Industrial Goods, Maschinenbau oder Wholesale ist ein Plus.
  • Analytisches Denken mit Mut zur Aussage: Du erkennst Muster und traust dich, daraus eine klare Empfehlung abzuleiten – auch wenn sie nicht die bequeme ist.
  • Kommunikation: Du erklärst einer Geschäftsführung, warum eine Entitätsstruktur eine Investition wert ist. Souverän, ohne zu vereinfachen.
  • Hands-on und geduldig mit Kundenrealität: TYPO3-Installationen von 2014, eine IT, die sechs Wochen für ein Deployment braucht, ein CMS ohne Zugriff auf die Meta-Ebene. Du kennst das und arbeitest trotzdem an Ergebnissen. Bei Unklarheiten holst du dir gezielt den nötigen Input aus dem Team und arbeitest anschließend eigenständig und zuverlässig weiter.
  • Excel beherrschst du im Schlaf
  • Sprachen: Kommunikationsstark in Deutsch und sicher in Englisch.


Was wir von Dir benötigen:

Mission started?! Dann brauchen wir von Dir:   

  • Deinen CV
  • Welche Vergütung Du Dir für Deine Performance vorstellst
  • Deine Kündigungsfrist bzw. möglicher Starttermin


Warum wir?

Wir glauben: Wer viel gibt, soll auch viel zurückbekommen. Deshalb erwarten dich bei uns Benefits, die über „Extras“ hinausgehen. Sie geben dir Freiheit, Flexibilität und die Möglichkeit, dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln, und machen deinen Arbeitsalltag einfach besser.

  • Teamspirit pur: Kollegiale Teams mit echtem Zusammenhalt, Hilfsbereitschaft und einer guten Portion Humor.
  • Transparente Strukturen: Flache Hierarchien und eine gelebte Open-Door-Mentalität - Austausch auf Augenhöhe ist selbstverständlich.
  • Open Vacation Policy: Neben deinen gesetzlichen Urlaubstagen kannst du dir mit unserer „Above & Beyond“-Regelung zusätzliche freie Tage gönnen.
  • Work from anywhere: Ob Home-Office oder temporär im Ausland - du entscheidest, wo du am produktivsten bist.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Großer Gleitzeitrahmen - du bestimmst deinen Rhythmus, mit Verlässlichkeit bei Kunden- und Teammeetings.
  • Modelle, die zu deinem Leben passen: Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, fix oder zeitlich begrenzt – wir finden gemeinsam die passende Lösung.
  • Spannende Projekte, innovativ, abwechslungsreich und mit steiler Lernkurve – bei uns gestaltest du echten Fortschritt mit.
  • Wachstum garantiert: Individuelles Weiterbildungsbudget für Workshops, Zertifizierungen oder Coachings.
  • Karrierepfade: Auch bei flachen Hierarchien sorgen klare Strukturen für deine Weiterentwicklung.
  • Mobility & Events: Bis zu 467 € fürs Öffi- oder Deutschlandticket, regelmäßige Teamevents und Besuche von Messen & Conventions.
  • Loft-Offices: Zentral gelegen, modern ausgestattet, kreativ – mit Raum für Austausch, Ideen und natürlich Snacks & Drinks.
  • Rewards: Prämiensystem für deine persönlichen und unternehmerischen Erfolge.

Diese Position ist im Consulting Cluster von TOWA auf Senior-Level angesiedelt. Das Gehalt liegt zwischen €60.000 und €75.000 brutto/Jahr (All-in). Die angegebene Range umfasst alle Gehaltsbestandteile und ist als Zielgehalt zu verstehen (z. B. inklusive variabler Anteile oder weiterer Benefits, sofern zutreffend). Im Falle einer Zusammenarbeit erstellen wir dir ein individuelles Angebot – die Einstufung innerhalb der Range richtet sich nach deinen Skills, deinem Verantwortungsbereich und deiner Erfahrung, niemals nach deinem vorherigen Gehalt.

Im Einklang mit der EU-Entgelttransparenzrichtlinie (2023/970) und den länderspezifischen Gleichbehandlungsgesetzen veröffentlichen wir für jede Rolle die Gehaltsspanne und fragen Kandidat:innen nicht nach ihrem aktuellen oder vorherigen Gehalt. Unsere Kriterien zur Gehaltsfestlegung – Cluster, Level, Skills, Verantwortungsbereich und Erfahrung – gelten unternehmensweit einheitlich. Du kannst während des gesamten Prozesses jederzeit schriftlich weitere Informationen zur Gehaltsspanne dieser Rolle oder zu unserer Vergütungspolitik anfordern.

Chancengleichheit

TOWA stellt nach Skills und Impact ein. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen aller qualifizierten Personen – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Hintergrund, Herkunft, Religion, sexueller Orientierung oder Behinderung. Die Stellenbezeichnung gilt für alle Geschlechter (m/w/d).


Deine Führungskraft

Dein Teamlead ist Anja Meusburger – Klicke hier um mehr über sie zu erfahren.
