  • Methodik dokumentieren: Du hältst fest, wie wir vorgehen – Prompt-Sets, Definitionen, Grenzen der Messung. Am Ende deines Praktikums existiert etwas, das ohne dich weiterläuft. Das ist der Teil, auf den du später im Bewerbungsgespräch zeigen kannst.
  • Mitdenken erlaubt, ausdrücklich: Du sitzt in Team-Terminen dabei, hörst mit, wenn Ergebnisse diskutiert werden, und darfst fragen, warum wir etwas so machen. Manchmal ist die ehrliche Antwort „weil wir es immer so gemacht haben“ – und dann ist deine Frage die beste des Tages.


Damit kannst Du punkten:

  • Studium oder Quereinstieg: Du studierst etwas mit Daten, Marketing, Wirtschaft, Medien oder Informatik im Master oder du kommst über einen anderen Weg und kannst erklären, warum dich das Thema packt. Wir sind an Köpfen interessiert, nicht an Studienordnungen.
  • Erste Praxiserfahrung: Mindestens eine relevante Station, in der du schon in einem Team mit echten Deadlines mitgearbeitet hast. Ein vorheriges Praktikum oder eine Werkstudentenstelle in einer Agentur, einer Beratung, einem B2B-Unternehmen oder einem internationalen Konzern, gerne auch Freelance-Arbeit oder ein eigenes Projekt mit Kunden. Das ist für uns keine Formalie: Wer den Projektalltag schon einmal von innen gesehen hat, steigt hier deutlich schneller ein.
  • Sorgfalt: Ein Großteil dieser Arbeit ist wiederholbare Messung. Wer dabei ungenau wird, produziert Daten, auf die man nichts stellen kann. Wenn du weißt, dass Genauigkeit deine Stärke ist, ist das hier mehr wert als jede Tool-Zertifizierung.
  • Neugier auf AI, nicht nur Nutzung: Du hast ChatGPT und Perplexity nicht nur benutzt, sondern dich schon gefragt, woher die Antworten eigentlich kommen. Eine eigene Beobachtung dazu ist uns lieber als eine Aufzählung von Tools.
  • Excel oder Sheets solide, und keine Angst vor größeren Datenmengen. Erste Berührung mit SQL, GA4 oder Search Console ist ein Plus.
  • Selbstständigkeit im Rahmen: Du fragst nach, wenn etwas unklar ist, statt zu raten und arbeitest dann eigenständig weiter, hands-on, ohne dass jemand nachschauen muss.
  • Sprachen: Sehr gutes Deutsch, sicheres Englisch.
  • Verfügbarkeit: Mindestens 6 Monate. Kürzer lohnt sich für dich nicht – die ersten Wochen gehen fürs Reinkommen drauf.


Was wir von Dir benötigen:

Mission started?! Dann brauchen wir von Dir:   

  • Deinen CV
  • Welche Vergütung Du Dir für Deine Performance vorstellst
  • Deine Kündigungsfrist bzw. möglicher Starttermin


Warum wir?

Ein Praktikum ist bei uns kein Parkplatz. Du arbeitest an einem Thema, das noch niemand fertig gelöst hat – mit echten Kundendaten, in einem Team, das dich fragt, was du gesehen hast.

  • Ein Thema mit Zukunft: AI Search ist keine Nische, die wieder verschwindet. Was du hier lernst, ist in zwei Jahren ein gesuchtes Profil und du kannst dann belegen, dass du von Anfang an dabei warst.
  • Echte Betreuung: Feste Ansprechperson, wöchentlicher Jour fixe, Zwischen- und Abschlussfeedback. Kein „Melde dich, wenn du was brauchst“.
  • Übernahmeperspektive, ehrlich benannt: Wir bauen dieses Feld auf und suchen parallel auf Senior-Level. Wenn es passt, ist der Weg über Junior in eine der beiden Rollen realistisch – wir versprechen es nicht, aber wir meinen es.
  • Teamspirit pur: Kollegiale Teams mit echtem Zusammenhalt, Hilfsbereitschaft und einer guten Portion Humor.
  • Transparente Strukturen: Flache Hierarchien und eine gelebte Open-Door-Mentalität – Austausch auf Augenhöhe ist selbstverständlich, auch als Praktikant:in.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Wir bekommen Studium und Praktikum zusammen. Prüfungszeiten planen wir ein, wenn du sie früh sagst.
  • Mobility & Events: Öffi-Ticket-Zuschuss, Teamevents und die Chance, auf Fachkonferenzen mitzufahren.
  • Loft-Offices: Zentral gelegen, modern ausgestattet – mit Raum für Austausch, Ideen und natürlich Snacks & Drinks.

Diese Position ist ein Praktikum im Consulting Cluster von TOWA. Die Vergütung beträgt 1.800 EUR brutto pro Monat auf Vollzeitbasis. Bei einem Teilzeit-Modell wird der Betrag aliquot angepasst.

Im Einklang mit der EU-Entgelttransparenzrichtlinie (2023/970) und den länderspezifischen Gleichbehandlungsgesetzen veröffentlichen wir für jede Rolle die Gehaltsspanne und fragen Kandidat:innen nicht nach ihrem aktuellen oder vorherigen Gehalt. Unsere Kriterien zur Gehaltsfestlegung – Cluster, Level, Skills, Verantwortungsbereich und Erfahrung – gelten unternehmensweit einheitlich. Du kannst während des gesamten Prozesses jederzeit schriftlich weitere Informationen zur Gehaltsspanne dieser Rolle oder zu unserer Vergütungspolitik anfordern.

Chancengleichheit

TOWA stellt nach Skills und Impact ein. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen aller qualifizierten Personen – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Hintergrund, Herkunft, Religion, sexueller Orientierung oder Behinderung. Die Stellenbezeichnung gilt für alle Geschlechter (m/w/d).

title: Account Executive (m/f/d)
description:
Your mission

At Bliq, we are building and launching driverless vehicles for everyday life and business operations across Europe.

We are looking for a Account Executive to help bring them to customers.

You will acquire business and individual customers across European markets and own the commercial process end-to-end: identify and engage prospects, run discovery, demonstrate the product in person, design the right commercial and operating model for each customer, build proposals, negotiate, and close.

Our customers can look very different. One week, you may be discussing a fleet deployment with a taxi or car-sharing company. The next, you may be showing the vehicle to a real-estate company, law firm, mobility operator, or prospective individual customer.

This is not a role where you inherit a mature market, established category, and optimized sales playbook. Driverless technology is only getting started in Europe. You will need to understand unfamiliar customer problems quickly, figure out how Bliq can solve them, and help us discover how this technology should be sold.

You will work closely with the Commercial Lead and founders to refine Bliq’s sales playbook market by market.

Responsibilities

  • Own the sales cycle from first conversation through signed contract

  • Build pipeline through targeted outbound and proactive prospecting across European markets

  • Run sharp discovery conversations that uncover customer operations, economics, pain points, and decision criteria

  • Conduct live Bliq vehicle demos and turn the experience into a compelling commercial conversation

  • Develop deployment concepts together with prospects, including use case, fleet size, operating model, responsibilities, economics, and rollout plan

  • Create proposals, commercial models, LOIs, and contracts together with the relevant internal teams

  • Navigate complex buying processes involving operators, management teams, fleet owners, partners, and other stakeholders

  • Build relationships with customers across mobility, taxi, car sharing, rental, real estate, professional services, and other relevant sectors

  • Own defined markets and be accountable for commercial progress within them

  • Keep CRM data, pipeline, next steps, and forecasts accurate

  • Test new segments, messages, channels, and commercial models and turn what works into repeatable processes

  • Work closely with the Customer Deployment team to make sure signed customers can actually be deployed successfully

  • Represent Bliq at customer meetings, industry events, demos, and market visits across Europe

  • Support B2C sales initiatives when they become part of the GTM strategy

  • Bring customer feedback directly into Bliq’s product, operations, and commercial decisions



Your profile

Apply if this describes you:

  • You have at least 2 years of Account Executive or comparable full-cycle sales experience

  • You are a hunter and enjoy creating opportunities rather than waiting for inbound demand

  • You learn quickly and can become credible on a complex technical product without hiding behind technical jargon

  • You are excellent face-to-face and comfortable walking into an important customer meeting, running the room, and demonstrating a physical product

  • You are customer-first and care about finding solutions that make customers satisfied

  • You have strong commercial judgment and understand how to turn customer needs into a viable deal

  • You write clearly and can produce concise, convincing emails, proposals, and commercial documents

  • You are highly organized and detail-oriented; pipeline hygiene, follow-ups, and commitments do not get lost

  • You have CRM experience and understand disciplined sales processes

  • Experience with tools such as Clay, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar is a plus

  • You know how to use AI to research, prepare, analyze, and move faster while keeping the thinking and customer judgment your own

  • You have a figure-it-out mindset and remain effective when there is no existing template for the problem

  • You are comfortable owning a market or commercial project and being measured by the outcome

  • You can work professionally in German and English; additional European languages are a plus

  • You are based in Berlin

  • You are willing to travel regularly across Europe

  • Experience selling hardware, mobility, automotive, physical technology, or other operationally complex products is a strong plus

This role will probably not suit you if you want an established sales process, a narrowly defined territory, a predictable product demo, or a manager telling you exactly what to do next.

It will suit you if you want to help create a category, sell something people can experience in the real world, and build the commercial machine while running it.


Why us?

  • Sell a product people are excited about

  • Build Bliq’s sales playbook together with the Commercial Lead

  • Work directly with the founders and senior team

  • Own meaningful customer relationships and markets from an early stage

  • Work on complex deals combining technology, vehicles, operations, economics, and regulation

  • See deals move from your first message to vehicles operating on public roads with the customer

  • Fast decisions, direct feedback, and no bureaucracy

  • Strong compensation package with meaningful upside for performance

  • Significant room to grow as Bliq expands across European markets

Tips for a successful application

  1. Show us that you can sell. Generic applications tell us very little.

  2. Tell us what you have personally owned and what results you produced.

  3. If you have built pipeline, opened a new market, sold a difficult product, or closed an unusual deal, tell us how.

  4. Use AI as a tool. Make sure the thinking and personality in your application are yours.

title: System Software Engineer (gn) Cloud & Simulation
description:
Your mission

At Wandelbots, we are building NOVA, a platform that makes industrial robot programming accessible to everyone. Our Simulation team develops the technologies that allow partners, customers, and internal teams to work with photorealistic digital twins of real production environments.

This includes a pipeline that transforms real-world scans into usable 3D scenes through Gaussian Splatting, as well as a browser-based streaming platform built on NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac Sim. Both technologies work today, but neither is yet operated as a product. Your mission is to change that.

The first step is internal standardization. We want to replace individually maintained environments and hand-crafted deployments with one reproducible, documented solution that teams can use independently: scene in, session out, without requiring the Simulation team to operate every setup.
The second step is external productization. The same capabilities need to be packaged so that partners and customers can operate them in their own environments. 
E.g. with versioned releases, stable interfaces, tenant isolation, diagnostics, upgrade paths, and documentation.

You will join the Simulation team and focus on the infrastructure and operational foundations of these systems. You will not be building them in isolation: Wandelbots has an established infrastructure team responsible for shared infrastructure and platform capabilities. You will work closely with that team while owning the simulation-specific workloads, deployment patterns, and operational requirements.

This is a hands-on engineering role with room to shape architecture and make technical decisions in collaboration with the teams involved.

What you will work on

  • Build and operate the GPU infrastructure required by our simulation workloads, including NVIDIA GPU Operator, device plugins, driver lifecycle, and GPU sharing through MIG or time slicing

  • Work with the infrastructure team to integrate simulation workloads into our shared Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure

  • Make deployments declarative and reproducible using Infrastructure as Code and GitOps, and help consolidate the tooling used across today’s environments

  • Own CI/CD and the container and image lifecycle for CUDA- and NGC-based workloads

  • Design scheduling and autoscaling for two distinct workload profiles: latency-sensitive interactive streaming sessions and compute-intensive Gaussian Splatting jobs

  • Turn the Gaussian Splatting pipeline into a reproducible workflow, from data capture and training to OpenUSD assets

  • Operate and extend our Omniverse and Isaac Sim streaming platform, including Kit App Streaming, session lifecycle, and tenant isolation

  • Establish the platform as an internal standard through self-service workflows, golden paths, templates, onboarding, and documentation

  • Prepare the solution for operation by partners and customers through packaged deployments, versioned releases, upgrade paths, and actionable diagnostics

  • Support deployments across cloud, on-premises, and partner-managed environments

  • Build meaningful observability using metrics, logs, GPU telemetry, and actionable alerting

  • Define the simulation-specific security and access model, including ingress, TURN and STUN for WebRTC, RBAC, secrets management, SSO, and tenant boundaries

  • Work closely with our robotics, product, and platform teams to ensure that the solution supports real development and customer workflows



Your profile

We are looking for an engineer who is interested in how complex systems are built, deployed, and operated, not only in delivering the next application feature.
You should bring:

  • Experience building or operating production systems in platform engineering, infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or systems software

  • Practical Kubernetes experience, including resource management, workload scheduling, and debugging distributed systems under load

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, and CI/CD, together with the ability to evaluate tools based on the problem rather than a fixed preference

  • Solid knowledge of Linux, containers, and networking

  • Good Python skills for automation, services, and data-processing workflows

  • Experience with GPU workloads, or a strong technical foundation and clear interest in working with drivers, CUDA, and GPU scheduling

  • The ability to turn working technology into a system that other teams can use independently

  • A strong sense of operational ownership, including documentation, diagnostics, maintainability, and reproducibility

  • Very good English; German is a plus


We do not expect candidates to have prior experience with every technology in this description. A strong systems foundation, the ability to learn unfamiliar components, and an interest in this problem space are more important than matching every item. The scope and responsibilities of the role will grow with your experience.


Nice to have

  • Experience turning an internally developed system into a product that can be operated in customer-controlled environments

  • Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Omniverse, Isaac Sim, Kit SDK, or OpenUSD

  • Experience with Gaussian Splatting, NeRF, photogrammetry, or comparable 3D reconstruction pipelines

  • Knowledge of WebRTC, pixel streaming, or other low-latency video technologies

  • Python, Rust, or Go skills sufficient to contribute to existing services and infrastructure tooling

  • Experience with robotics or simulation, such as ROS 2 or sim-to-real workflows

  • Experience with multi-tenant platforms, air-gapped deployments, or customer environments with specific security and compliance requirements



Why us?

Make an impact!
Work on an innovative, deep tech product that adds value to the robotics world and to society! Become a crucial part of something new, big and exciting where you can truly make an impact!

Our teams inspire!
Cross-functional communication is key. You'll get to know many of your 100+ colleagues. Collaborate with great people on our international teams who value knowledge sharing and unique ways of doing things!

Be authentic!
Work in a value-driven environment where everything may not be perfect, but we're working on it! Your feedback is required while you receive feedback and appreciation for your work!

Help others!
You can have up to 3 days of volunteer time off to help your favorite charity.

Develop yourself!
We offer training and mental health opportunities so that you can develop both mentally and professionally.

And there is even more!
Enjoy our free lunch, snacks and drinks, team events, 30 days of annual vacation + additional rest during Christmas season until New Year. If your child gets sick, we assure that a 100% of your usual earnings will be paid while you take care of your little one.

IONITY baut ein europaweites Netzwerk von High-Power-Ladestationen auf und betreibt dieses. Die Rolle verbindet Projektmanagement, Infrastrukturentwicklung und Stakeholder-Management. Du koordinierst interne Teams, Behörden, Grundstückseigentümer, Netzbetreiber, Baufirmen, Installationspartner und spezialisierte Partner auf gemeinsame Meilensteine, Entscheidungen und Qualitätsstandards.   • Du übernimmst die ganzheitliche Verantwortung für die Umsetzung eines Portfolios von HPC-Ladestandorten in der DACH-Region, mit besonderem Fokus auf die komplexesten, risikoreichsten oder strategisch wichtigsten Standorte.   • Du führst die funktionsübergreifende Umsetzung über die Bereiche Planung und Genehmigung, Bau, Netzanschluss, Logistik etc. hinweg, treibst zeitnahe Entscheidungen voran, löst Konflikte und stellst sicher, dass kritische Schnittstellen zwischen Grundstück, Tiefbau, Elektrotechnik, Netzanschluss, Installation der Ladehardware, Prüfung und Inbetriebnahme aktiv gesteuert werden.
  • Du steuerst externe Planungsbüros, Auftragnehmer, Installationsunternehmen und weitere Umsetzungspartner direkt, setzt klare Erwartungen, überwachst die Leistung, steuerst die operative Umsetzung sowie kommerzielle Risiken und stellst sicher, dass die Partner die vereinbarten Ergebnisse liefern.

Du stellst tragfähige Optionen, Auswirkungen und Empfehlungen dar und wägst dabei Zeitplan, Kosten, Qualität, technische Machbarkeit und die Anforderungen der Stakeholder gegeneinander ab.

description:
Join Quantum-Systems and bring autonomous trucks into real-world operations. As Chief Engineer Autonomous Trucking, you are the technical owner of the entire program and you identify yourself with the success of this product: you set the technical direction, shape the system architecture, and turn customer needs into an integrated, executable delivery plan. You orchestrate the complete system, from base vehicle and autonomy hardware to the autonomy software stack and full system integration, and you drive it to maturity, primarily for defense logistics applications in regulated environments.

You work in an extremely tight partnership with Product Management: they own what the customer needs, you own how we achieve it technically and by when we deliver. Together you balance product ambition against engineering reality, make trade-offs consciously, and keep one integrated plan that the whole organization can execute against.

This is a senior individual contributor role with maximum leverage: you align workstream leads, domain experts, truck OEM partners, and central functions into one integrated product and one executable delivery plan. You are the technical counterpart to Product, Sales, Supply Chain, Operations, external stakeholder (OEMs), and the credible engineering voice towards senior leadership.


What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Own the Technical Program

    • Own the end-to-end technical orchestration of our autonomous trucking program with strong focus on integration, execution readiness, and delivery reliability.

    • Define and maintain the integrated technical roadmap: milestones, dependencies, and critical path from development through deployment, performance, and certification goals.

    • Identify integration gaps, decision bottlenecks, and execution risks early; escalate with judgement and propose solution options

    • Ensure technical trade-offs are transparent and made consciously across product, engineering, and operations.

  • Drive System Integration to series industrialisation and production

    • Align technical integration and ensure convergence across base vehicle, autonomy hardware stack, autonomy software stack (modular and End2End planner approaches), verification and validation, ground operations and test, and systems engineering including safety and security.

    • Drive technical maturity from subsystem status to validated system behavior; ensure interfaces are clear, owned, and validated between the teams

    • Push for integration planning with the right cadence of reviews, demos, test evidence, and decision points.

  • Partner with Product Management

    • Work in an extremely tight loop with Product Management: they own what the customer needs, you own how and by when we deliver it in lockstep alignment with engineering management.

    • Translate product intent into technical execution clarity; challenge unclear scope, unclear priorities, or missing system implications early.

    • Shape realistic sequencing between product ambition and engineering capacity.

    • Build trusted, eye-level working relationships with truck OEM engineering teams and manage the joint technical interfaces, handovers, and delivery commitments.

    • Act as the strong technical counterpart to Sales, Supply Chain, and Operations: connect program needs with sourcing timelines, service concepts, and operational readiness.

    • Create alignment across internal engineering teams and domains on priorities, interfaces, and expected delivery contributions.

  • Be a Senior Technical Leader

    • Operate with high autonomy and high judgement; represent the technical program in reviews up to C-level.

    • Be a calm, credible, and sharp voice in high-stakes discussions, internally and towards partners and customers.

    • Raise the bar on accountability, collaboration, and delivery discipline across workstream leads and domain experts, without creating unnecessary process overhead.



What you bring to the team:

  • Engineering degree in a relevant field (e.g. Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, or comparable).

  • 10+ years of experience in autonomous driving or field robotics, ideally with several years in autonomous trucking.

  • Outstanding technical depth across the full autonomous driving system: autonomy software (perception, planning, control, end to end planner architectures), autonomy hardware (compute, sensors, user interfaces), base vehicle hardware architecture, and system integration.

  • Proven experience delivering complex systems in regulated environments; defense background is a strong plus but not mandatory.

  • Outstanding technical project and program management skills: roadmapping, critical path management, risk management, and delivery steering of multi-team workstreams.

  • Track record of working with vehicle OEMs, ideally truck OEMs, on joint development and integration programs.

  • Outstanding communication skills: condensate complex technical discussions into actionable items per team.

  • Systems thinker: you think in milestones and integration maturity, not in isolated component optimization.

  • Fluent in English; German is a strong plus.

  • High ownership, pragmatic, hands-on mindset; willingness to travel to OEM, partner, and test sites.

Your Benefits: 

  • Direct impact: See your contributions rapidly integrated from cutting-edge research into industrialized products, flying in the field within short development cycles. 

  • Culture & Environment: A dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative startup environment with flat hierarchies, efficient collaboration, and a strong emphasis on continuous learning opportunities. 

  • Work-life Balance: We offer flexible work schedules, and 30 days of paid vacation each year to support your personal and professional life. 

  • Lunch Benefit: We promote healthy eating and the well-being of our employees with a monthly lunch budget. 

  • Health & Wellness: We support your physical well-being with a company-subsidized eGym Wellpass membership, giving you access to thousands of gyms and sports facilities.

title: Software Release & Configuration Manager (m/f/d)
description:
As a Software Release & Configuration Manager (m/f/d), you will be the central point of control for all software delivery activities across multiple software engineering teams. You will oversee feature development progress, manage release schedules, and ensure timely delivery of high-quality software for our advanced drone systems.

You will coordinate daily operations, manage tickets and workflow, and act as the decision-maker when priorities conflict, always keeping delivery commitments on track. This roles requires a mix of technical understanding of software architecture, organizational skills and assertive leadership. In a highly skilled team, you will play a key role in pushing the boundaries of modern software solutions for our high-tech drones.

You will work closely with stakeholders from our software teams as well as adjacent departments (such as hardware development and product management). By ensuring timely software deliveries, you will support Quantum-Systems in its mission to become the leader for aerial data collection solutions with unmanned aerial systems (sUAV). 

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Own the release process for all software components, including embedded firmware, ground control software, and AI mission packages.

  • Monitor and track development progress across multiple teams, ensuring alignment with release timelines.

  • Manage configuration and version control for all software artifacts and environments.

  • Lead daily stand-ups and coordination meetings, driving clarity and accountability.

  • Maintain and prioritize the backlog, ensuring tickets are properly managed and resolved.

  • Act as the decision authority when trade-offs are needed to meet delivery deadlines.

  • Define and enforce release policies, including branching strategies, quality gates, and approval workflows.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders (engineering, QA, product management) to ensure smooth and predictable releases.

  • Continuously improve release processes, introducing automation and best practices where possible.

  • Proven experience in managing projects and leading teams.

  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, version control systems (GitLab/GitHub), and branching strategies.

  • Familiarity with embedded software development and multi-component systems.

title: Technical Product Manager - DevEx
description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

Your mission is to make it dramatically easier for our engineers to ship features and learn from them quickly, securely, and reliably. You'll aim for small-startup speed while meeting the quality bar of a large financial institution. Velocity here means removing friction and toil from the path between idea and learning, not asking people to work harder.

AI is a big part of the opportunity, and we're looking for a PM who is optimistic about its possibilities but pragmatic about what actually works. The goal is not to adopt the latest shiny AI tool; it's to deeply understand your internal users, experiment, and honestly evaluate what solves their problems, whether that's AI, process changes, or boring tooling that just works.

The Technical Product Manager - DevEx will:

  • Lead a team of engineers with full ownership of how we deliver new features for our users and use AI solutions to remove impactful friction for our engineers and product managers.
  • Define product goals, metrics, and roadmaps based on user needs and mission impact.
  • Drive user research within our engineering and product teams.
  • Write clear, compelling design docs and facilitate async, fast-moving decision-making.
  • Over-communicate context, priorities, and decisions to ensure team alignment.
  • Adjust priorities quickly based on feedback, experiments, or new learnings.
  • Solve problems holistically, whether through product features, ops tooling or process changes.

In this role, you'll...

  • Own the developer experience holistically, including any internal or external tooling needed to support it.
  • Research and implement solutions for how we can use AI to remove engineering and development friction. 
  • Build your own prototypes to test ideas where possible.
  • Relentlessly gather feedback (by talking to users and looking at data) to deeply understand the problem space and our engineers' and product managers' needs.
  • Work from first principles to understand the engineers' and product managers' biggest problems and then figure out how our tooling should work to solve those problems.
  • Prioritize the biggest problems blocking the engineers' and product managers' productivity and the impact on delivering value to our users fast and securely.
  • Directly manage the DevEx team to help them grow in their careers, partnering with the Tech Lead, who will own the technical bar.

Key Details

  • This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (UK, Spain, USA (East Coast), Canada, Kenya and Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, or Burkina Faso
  • Wave provides a yearly $1,200 stipend to support co-working meetups with teammates.
  • Remote team members are expected to travel to our operational markets (e.g. Senegal or Côte d'Ivoire) at least once per year. Exceptions apply, but we've found this key to understanding our users and product.
  • Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your level and location, we offer a salary up to $237,500 USD, plus a generous equity package.
  • Major benefits:
    • Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents, and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country).
    • 6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance.
    • Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 21-30 days per year. 
    • $10,000 annual charitable donation matching.

Requirements

  • Have 3+ years of product management experience and hands-on engineering background (you've shipped production code) or direct PM ownership of a developer experience, or developer productivity function.
  • Proven success in overseeing all elements of the product development lifecycle, such as user research, design, implementation and evaluation.
  • Speak fluent English
  • Bonus if you:
    • Have proven experience with successfully rolling out AI-based solutions in a larger org
    • Have professional experience in a consumer fintech company

You might be a good fit if you

  • Resonate deeply with how we do product and have experience working that way.
  • Are continuously iterating on using AI in real workflows with honest evaluation.
  • Are a strong communicator who can inspire and lead by influence.
  • Are great at coordinating across teams and excel at communicating across multiple cultures.
  • Take ownership for outcomes and do whatever you can to make them close to inevitable.
  • Have strong instincts for asking questions that could move the needle.
  • Have the courage and persistence to replan when feedback or new information arrives.
  • Always listen with empathy but ruthlessly prioritize based on impact.

About Product at Wave

Product has always been very important to us at Wave, starting from day one with two very strong product-minded founders. Product Managers play a central role in our organization, impacting large chunks of the company around them, similar to the founders they were shaped after years ago.

Our approach to building products may not be what you've seen in other places. Our processes are lightweight, informed by principles instead of methodologies and our PMs don't just manage backlogs full of polished tickets. Read our write-up on product at Wave!

If you're excited to own a real problem end-to-end, set your own goals, and guide a team toward outcomes that matter for real people, you'll feel right at home here.

If that's you, we'd love to meet you.

Our team

  • We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.
  • We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.
  • We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.
  • We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.
  • We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.

How to apply

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.

Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

description:
Hi, I'm Tom Clark - CIO, CISO, and hx employee #9. I'm the executive in charge of our Systems & Security function. I joined in 2020 at seed stage, and I've been here through Series A, Series B, and everything in between - watching us grow from nine people to more than 250. I’m six years in, and I've never been more excited about what's ahead.

Fun fact: I didn't come from insurance. I came from TV and media - if you've ever used BBC iPlayer, ITVX, or listened to Capital Radio, I helped make them. I ended up in insurance and became, perhaps unexpectedly, one of the industry's biggest cheerleaders.

I know what you're thinking: insurance isn't cool. I can change your mind in five minutes, or your money back. And the best bit? What we're building with hxOS is cooler still. We take a product-centric, customer-centric view to internal IT - the same rigour and craft you'd bring to any customer-facing product. That's what makes this role different, and it's what I'm most excited about.

Let’s speak soon.
- TC

 

About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry: which risks to take, and how to price them. These are decisions that shape real-world outcomes - whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision. We help them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally. We are already trusted by nearly 60 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do: from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

About the SYSSEC team

hxOS is hx's internal operating system. It's the platform every person in the company uses and builds on: devices, meeting rooms, core applications, SSO, AI tools, data infrastructure, security and compliance. The Systems & Security (SYSSEC) team builds it, runs it, and keeps improving it. It'll never be finished. That's the point.

hxOS is as much a vision as a current reality. The foundations are solid, day to day runs well because it has to, nothing gets built on shaky ground. The more ambitious layers - federated, AI-native, product-led infrastructure that the whole business builds on - are what the team is building now.

About the role

The Systems Associate is one of the most visible faces of SYSSEC. They're the first point of contact for everything coming into the team, and the work ranges widely: a day might move from troubleshooting a device, to helping a team get more out of a new AI integration, to contributing to a piece of infrastructure the whole company will rely on. What ties it together is ownership: of the service experience, of the queue, and progressively of the platform itself.

The career story here is real. This person becomes hxOS's internal expert, the colleague people turn to when they want to understand what's possible, get more out of their tools, or navigate something new. That's a rare combination of technical depth, operational credibility, and genuine impact at the centre of how the company works.

This is an Associate/IC1 role, suited to a talented graduate or someone with a year or two behind them.

What you'll be doing

Own the front door. Triage, prioritise, route, and keep stakeholders informed on everything coming into SYSSEC, applying an ITIL/ITSM lens to how work arrives, gets handled, and gets resolved. How it feels to reach out to SYSSEC starts and ends with how this person shows up.

Improve the service, continuously. Good enough today is a problem tomorrow. Look for recurring patterns, find root causes, and change the conditions that created them, through better templates, self-serve paths, proactive communication, and process work that makes repeat tickets rarer over time.

Build things that reduce the work. Scripts, automations, integrations, paved-road workflows. Engineer toil out of the system rather than just processing it, and contribute to the broader hxOS integration layer: connectors, routing logic, self-serve tooling that makes the platform more capable over time.

Be a partner to the business. As the internal expert in hxOS, help colleagues get more out of their devices, applications, and AI tools. description:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. The Role

This role reports to the VP of Product Marketing and owns product marketing for the Billing product group. You will work across Product, Growth, Revenue Marketing, Sales, Finance, Solutions, Customer Success, Support, and Brand to turn customer insight into a clear story, a strong go-to-market plan, and measurable market impact.

Monetisation becomes harder as software businesses grow. Pricing models, subscriptions, payments, invoicing, and revenue operations can become a patchwork that slows launches, creates risk, and pulls teams away from their customers.

You will turn a complex commercial problem into a clear story for the people who buy, build, operate, and grow software businesses.   • Use AI to improve research, synthesis, analysis, competitive intelligence, workflow automation, and product marketing quality, with strong judgement and verification.

  • A track record of bringing complex B2B, fintech, payments, billing, infrastructure, or platform products to market.

  • Experience leading high-impact launches, migrations, packaging changes, or commercial initiative with measurable results.

  • Strong customer discovery, segmentation, positioning, storytelling, and commercial judgement.

  • The ability to connect product detail to outcomes such as growth, retention, efficiency, flexibility, and confidence.

  • Comfort working with technical, product, finance, operations, sales, solutions, support, and executive audiences.

description:
📍 London - Hybrid. 2 days per week in our London office, 3 days remote / work from home

We've spent the last three years transforming how our People Team operates. Now we're looking for someone to own the machine and work out what comes next!


About the role

We're looking for a People Operations Lead to own the operating layer of our People function, managing our People Operations Specialist and reporting directly to our People Director.

This is a slightly unusual brief, because we're looking for a very particular combination of experience.

First and foremost, you need to be an experienced, hands-on People Operations person. But you also need to have previously worked as an accountant, or have substantial professional accountancy experience.

And we mean accountancy specifically. Experience partnering with Finance, managing a People budget or processing payroll isn't the same thing.

Why such a specific combination? Because we've seen first-hand just how well it can work.

We've seen the value that a professional accountancy background can bring when combined with strong People Operations experience - financial discipline, an instinct for controls and data, and an analytical approach to understanding how systems and processes work. We're now deliberately looking for that combination again.

This isn't a traditional HR Operations role, and we're not looking for someone to simply keep existing processes running. We want someone who's genuinely curious about how and why things work - someone who spots friction, interrogates the data, challenges the way we've always done things and builds something better.

You'll inherit a strong foundation. Over the last three years we've streamlined manual processes, invested in our People technology and changed the way our People function operates. There's plenty we're proud of - but we're definitely not done!

You'll own our People operations, systems and data infrastructure across the end-to-end colleague lifecycle, making sure the fundamentals run brilliantly while continuously looking for opportunities to simplify, automate and improve them.

You'll also take significant ownership of our reward infrastructure, including quarterly pay reviews, salary benchmarking and banding, benefits and gender pay gap reporting. You'll work closely with our People Partners, Talent, Finance, Payroll and Tech teams, so this is a highly collaborative role with influence across Goodlord.

And increasingly, you'll help us answer a bigger question: what work should technology be doing for us?

We're already exploring how AI and agentic workflows can remove repetitive work across areas such as onboarding, colleague queries, document management, data validation and reporting. You don't need to arrive as an AI expert, but you do need to be excited about the possibilities, willing to experiment and comfortable helping us work out where technology can genuinely make things better.

If you get a kick out of taking something that already works, understanding it properly and making it simpler, smarter and better, we'd love to hear from you.

Who are you?

You're probably someone who sees People Operations a little differently.

You care about delivering a brilliant colleague experience, but you're just as interested in the systems, data and processes underneath it.

You don't accept a seven-step process because it's always had seven steps. You'll want to understand why it's there, whether we still need it and what would happen if we did it differently.

What does that mean in practice?

  • You're naturally curious and analytical. You ask good questions, get underneath problems and use data rather than instinct alone to make decisions.

  • You love improving how things work. You've reviewed, redesigned and implemented processes rather than simply inherited and administered them.

  • You're comfortable getting into the detail while still seeing the bigger picture - whether that's interrogating a spreadsheet, configuring a workflow or digging into an HRIS.

  • You're pragmatic, comfortable with ambiguity and a confident collaborator. You can turn an idea into something that actually works and bring people with you when something needs to change.

What we need from you

  • Previous professional experience working as an accountant or in a substantive accountancy role. This is essential for this particular hire.

  • Significant People Operations experience, with evidence that you've owned and designed end-to-end People processes, not simply operated processes someone else created.

  • Hands-on experience owning or significantly shaping People systems and data using a modern tech stack, including an HRIS (we use Personio, but we're of course open to others!) and/or headcount planning systems, alongside strong analytical and advanced Excel skills.

  • Experience across reward and benefits, ideally including ownership of pay review cycles, salary benchmarking and banding, benefits and gender pay gap reporting.

  • A track record of continuous improvement - spotting friction, getting underneath the root cause and leading meaningful changes that have made processes simpler, better or more scalable.

  • An active interest in AI and automation and how they can change the way People teams operate. You'll be comfortable experimenting with new tools and ways of working.

  • You'll be comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment and working across People Partnering, Talent, Finance, Payroll and Tech to solve problems and make change happen.

It would also be great if you have

  • Experience working in a high-growth, scale-up or similarly fast-moving environment.

  • Hands-on experience building or implementing AI/agentic workflows that are being used in practice.

And one thing you won't need

A particular HR qualification. We care much more about what you've actually built, improved and owned than whether you have CIPD after your name.

A little more about the contract

This is initially a three-month fixed-term contract. We're continuing to think about the longer-term shape of our People team, so there is the potential for the role to become permanent if there's a strong mutual fit and an ongoing need.

We're also open to part-time working for the right person. Finding the right combination of People Operations and professional accountancy experience matters more to us than insisting on a particular working pattern.

title: Account Director (New Business)
description:
Join Neudata - Account Director (New Business)

Introducing Neudata:

Neudata is the global leader in alternative and market data intelligence, helping investors, hedge funds and corporates discover, evaluate, and use data to make smarter decisions. Our independence is what really sets us apart - we provide objective, unbiased intelligence that our clients trust and depend on.

With offices in London, New York, and Shanghai and a team of 100 people, we connect a vast global network of buyers and providers through our market-leading platforms and specialist consulting - and by providing a clear view of the data landscape, we help organisations navigate complexity and find their competitive edge. Joining Neudata really puts you at the heart of the fintech industry, where your work directly influences the data-driven strategies of the world's most sophisticated organisations.

The Role:

We're looking for an Account Director (New Business) to take our Scout and Ranger platforms to data buyers across EMEA and APAC: hedge funds, asset managers, private equity firms and the fast-growing world of AI. This is a pure new business role, and you'll own your territory end to end, from spotting the opportunity through to signing the deal.

You'll be the face of Neudata in front of some of the most sophisticated investors in the market, running story-led demonstrations, guiding hands-on trials alongside our research analysts, and building relationships with the people who decide how their firms use external data. There is real scope to grow the role too, including the potential to manage an SDR or a wider SDR team as the territory develops.

Your Key Responsibilities:

  • Own a European and Asia-Pacific territory of institutional investor prospects, driving new business through proactive outreach, field trips and lead generation campaigns across email and social

  • Run the full sales cycle: leading discovery and qualification calls, delivering value-based, story-led demonstrations of Scout and Ranger, then negotiating commercial terms and closing in line with quota

  • Manage hands-on platform trials in partnership with our research analysts, aligning technical and business criteria so prospects can see the value for themselves

  • Represent Neudata on stage and on the ground, presenting at our own high-profile events and at external conferences in the UK and overseas

  • Become a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, from Heads of Data and portfolio managers through to procurement leads

  • Keep your pipeline sharp with rigorous CRM discipline and accurate forecasting, and feed market insight back to our product and research teams to help shape where we go next

What You'll Bring:

  • Strong experience in data, research or information sales, ideally into financial services, with a proven track record of originating and closing complex new logo deals

  • A real understanding of how investment firms buy, particularly asset managers and hedge funds, and of the stakeholders involved along the way

  • Sharp commercial acumen and the confidence to negotiate and close

  • Outstanding presentation and communication skills, in person and online, in front of senior and technical audiences alike

  • Genuine enthusiasm for alternative data, market data and investment research, and curiosity about where the data landscape is heading

  • Experience coaching or managing SDRs is a bonus

Our Benefits & Perks:

  • 25 days' annual leave, plus an extra day for each year of service (up to 30 days), alongside one paid volunteering day and two paid study days per year 📅

  • Hybrid and flexible working, including working from anywhere for up to 10 working days per year from a location of your choosing 🌎

  • Private medical insurance via Vitality (including dental, optical, and hearing) ✚

  • Enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental policies 👨‍👩‍👧

  • Enhanced pension scheme via NEST 📈

  • Employee referral bonus of £1,000 per successful new hire you refer 💸

Key Details:

  • Location: London (Moorgate) with hybrid working. Frequent travel across Europe, the Middle East and North America is anticipated

  • Salary: Competitive base salary and commission structure

  • Start Date: ASAP

  1. Initial screening call with our Talent Acquisition Manager

  2. First-stage competency interview

  3. Meetings with key Neudata stakeholders

  4. Final stage interview

title: Head of Analytics
AIT MGSE Engineer - Lunar Lander
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.


As part of this initiative, we are developing a lunar lander capable of precision landing and reusable operations. To support this effort, we are establishing a dedicated remote test site in the United Arab Emirates to perform hot-fire propulsion testing and hopper flight demonstrations.

We want you as a talented AIT MGSE Engineer to help us in our mission by designing and delivering the MGSEs needed for the preparation and testing of our Lunar Lander.

Key Responsibilities

In your capacity as AIT MGSE Engineer, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day duties will include:

  • Work closely with Engineering and AIT colleagues to understand and refine the requirements/timelines for the different MGSEs that we will need for various assembly or testing activities.

  • Conceptualise, design (CAD including manufacturing drawings), procure and commission the MGSEs.

  • Confirm with mechanical analysis/hand calculations/proof tests that the design is compatible with the external loads.

  • Discuss with suppliers the MGSE designs for ease of manufacturing and with the most adequate processes.

  • Follow up the manufacturing/procurement with the suppliers (with the support of our supply chain team) and answer any technical questions/concerns ensuring timely delivery of all items.

  • Provide necessary instructions and support the assembly / commissioning / implementation of these MGSEs.

What we would love to see from you

In the role of AIT MGSE Engineer ideally, you will have the following:

  • Mechanical / Aerospace engineering degree or similar with focus on machine / structural design.

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in CAD design + drafting (using Siemens NX or similar) and FE analysis (using Hypermesh or similar).

  • Good understanding of machine design and different manufacturing processes (e.g. machining, welding, etc), design for manufacturing and GD&T.

  • Familiarity with standard margin calculation methodologies for various applications like beam design, bolted joints, welds, etc.

  • Experience with planning/execution of mechanical tests in-house would be a plus.

  • Good at documentation including design descriptions, assembly instructions, test reports, etc.

  • Creative with innovative ideas and technical problem solving/troubleshooting skills.

  • Basic hands-on experience with mechanical assembly and simple machining tools like drilling machine.

  • Previous experience in space AIT and MGSE design would be highly appreciated.

  • Good English communication skills (French would be a plus).

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly.

Votre Mission

Rattaché(e) directement à la Direction Administratif et Financier, en lien étroit avec les équipes opérationnelles, vous êtes le/la garant(e) du contrôle interne de la paie et de la fiabilité des données sociales. La paie est externalisée auprès d’un prestataire : votre rôle n’est pas de la produire mais d’en assurer la préparation, le contrôle et la coordination de bout en bout.

Vous évoluerez dans un environnement dynamique et agile, dans un contexte de structuration où vous devrez faire preuve de rigueur, de polyvalence et être force de proposition afin de contribuer à l’avancement d’un vaste panel de missions tels que :

  • Pilotage et contrôle de la paie externalisée

    • Collecte, consolidation et transmission des éléments variables de paie au prestataire (entrées/sorties, absences, variables, primes, notes de frais impactant la paie) selon un calendrier de paie maîtrisé ;

    • Contrôle de la saisie des temps par les salariés (suivi des congés etc) ;

    • Collecte des déclarations sociales produites par le prestataire (DSN, charges sociales, organismes de prévoyance et de mutuelle) et suivi des éventuelles anomalies jusqu’à résolution ;

    • Rapprochement de la paie avec la comptabilité en lien avec le CFO et l’expert comptable (écritures de paie, provisions congés payés, comptes de tiers sociaux).

  • Administration du personnel et cycle de vie collaborateur

    • Gestion administrative des entrées : DPAE, rédaction des contrats et avenants, affiliations mutuelle et prévoyance, visites médicales, création des dossiers collaborateurs ;

    • Suivi des évolutions en cours de vie (avenants, mobilités, changements de temps de travail) et des sorties (documents de fin de contrat, coordination avec la paie et le management) ;

    • Suivi des absences, congés, arrêts de travail, IJSS et dossiers de prévoyance ;

    • Gestion des dispositifs collectifs et avantages (titres-restaurant, mutuelle, mobilité durable, remboursements transport) ;

    • Tenue et fiabilisation des obligations administratives : registre unique du personnel, affichages, archivage et conformité RGPD des données sociales.

  • Coordination des prestataires et interlocuteurs externes

    • Interlocuteur(trice) de référence du cabinet de paie : animation du rythme de collaboration, cadrage des livrables, respect des échéances et arbitrage des points bloquants ;

    • Point de contact avec les organismes externes (URSSAF, organismes de retraite et de prévoyance, médecine du travail, OPCO, mutuelle) en lien avec le prestataire et le CFO;

  • Data & Process Owner RH

    • Élaboration et documentation de l’ensemble des processus administratifs RH et de l’outillage associé (SIRH), dans un contexte de croissance et avec la perspective d’intégration de nouvelles entités ;

    • Garantie de la qualité et de la cohérence de la donnée sociale entre le SIRH, la paie et les outils Finance.

  • Conformité sociale et missions ponctuelles

    • Veille sur la réglementation sociale et l’application de la convention collective, avec appui de conseils externes sur les sujets complexes ;

    • Contribution aux obligations et échéances annuelles (index égalité professionnelle, déclarations obligatoires, préparation des audits) ;

title: Account Executive Firm Expansion
description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

Afin d’accompagner notre croissance et répondre à nos enjeux 2026, nous ouvrons un nouveau poste au sein de l’équipe Sales en charge de la relation avec les clients SMEs des cabinets comptables partenaires de Pennylane.

Tu auras un rôle central en étant le point de contact privilégié des cabinets comptables souhaitant déployer Pennylane chez leurs clients

En effet, depuis 1 an, nous accélérons fortement dans l’acquisition de nouveaux cabinets comptables. L’outil Pennylane prenant tout son sens lorsque les Experts Comptables et leurs clients travaillent ensemble dessus, c’est dans leur intérêt d’équiper au maximum leurs clients.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

  • En échangeant avec les cabinets comptables partenaires pour identifier les SMEs de leurs portefeuilles les plus à même de pouvoir s’équiper de Pennylane.

  • En mettant en place des actions commerciales terrains (évènements physiques, webinaires, journée portes ouvertes) afin de faire connaître Pennylane auprès des SMEs de nos cabinets comptables partenaires.

  • En gérant de l’ensemble du cycle de vente de Pennylane sur ces SMEs (Qualification, Démo, Closing).

Tu travailleras main dans la main avec:

  • Les Account Executives Cabinets Comptables : ils sont en charge de vendre Pennylane à un maximum de cabinets comptables.

  • Les Account Managers : ils gèrent la relation commerciale avec le cabinet comptable et la coordination des projets de monétisation des SMEs avec nos cabinets comptables partenaires.

 

A quoi ressembleront tes débuts chez nous?

 

3 premiers mois :

  • Tu apprends à connaître Pennylane, sa vision, ses équipes afin de t'y sentir pleinement intégré

  • Tu intègres la sales academy afin de connaître parfaitement le rôle de chacun et de saisir le fonctionnement de l'équipe sales au global

  • Tu es formé par ton manager afin de prendre tes marques au sein de l'équipe

  • Tu montes en compétences sur l’outil

  • Tu prends en main tes prospects, accompagné par ton manger

  • Tu deviens autonome sur des ventes simples

4 à 8 mois

  • Tu gères en autonomie tes premières ventes complexes

  • Tu traites des leads de plus en plus complexes et stratégiques pour l'entreprise

  • Tu participes aux améliorations des process au sein de l'équipe et partage tes bonnes pratiques

  • Tu collabores avec les autres équipes de Pennylane (customer care, produit, sales...) afin de transmettre tes retours clients et participer à l'amélioration continue de notre plateforme

Et ensuite... :

  • Tu deviens un(e) AE confirmé (et donc un expert du produit), et tu es capable de gérer n'importe quel type de lead

  • Tu es owner d'un ou de plusieurs side project.s

  • Tu contribues activement à la mise à jour des process dans notre base interne (Notion)

  • Tu participes au mentoring et à la formation des nouveaux arrivants dans l'équipe

Process de recrutement

- Un premier entretien avec Orane : Senior Business Recruiter (30 min)

- Un deuxième entretien de fit avec Stan, Manager de l’équipe (45 min)

- Une mise en situation + case study avec Stan, Manager de l’équipe et un membre de l'équipe (1h)

  • Suivre la satisfaction métier après chaque évolution

  • Assurer une veille produit et métier pour garantir la pertinence des fonctionnalités

You'll hunt, qualify, and open doors so our Account Executives can close. You'll learn how to prospect like a pro, pitch like a consultant, and build the foundations of a sales career — with the goal of joining us full-time at the end of your internship.

1 month:

3 months:

  • Consistently hit monthly meeting targets through a mix of outbound calls, emails, and LinkedIn outreach.

End of internship (5-6 months):

  • Be performing at or near full quota, ready to hit the ground running as a full-time BDR.

  • Have tested and proposed new outbound tactics (copy, sequences, channels).

  • Convert to a full-time contract (CDI) if you perform well.

Who you are
This is for you if:

  • You're ambitious, competitive, and hungry to prove yourself.

  • You thrive on challenges and don't shy away from the grind of outbound sales.

title: Clinical Data Manager RWD/RWE
description:
À propos de Lifen

Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales peuvent transformer le système de santé, à condition qu’elles soient accessibles. Mieux les faire circuler, c’est réduire la charge administrative, mieux coordonner les soins et accélérer la recherche clinique.

Depuis 2015, nous développons des solutions qui aident les professionnels de santé à partager les informations médicales et les chercheurs à exploiter des données de santé. Plus de 150 personnes travaillent chez Lifen, depuis nos bureaux et à distance. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé en France.

Notre équipe

L’équipe Clinical Ops intervient au cœur de nos projets de recherche clinique fondés sur des données de santé. Elle transforme des documents médicaux en données structurées, nécessaires à la constitution de cohortes patients et à la préparation des exports utilisés dans nos projets de recherche.

Aujourd’hui, l’équipe structure environ 100 à 200 cas patients par semaine. Notre ambition : tripler cette capacité dans les 9 prochains mois, tout en maintenant un haut niveau de qualité des données.

Pour y parvenir, nous cherchons une personne capable de reprendre le management de l’équipe, mais surtout de piloter le flux de production, d’anticiper la charge et de porter une démarche d’amélioration continue avec les équipes Produit, IA et Engineering.

C’est un rôle à la croisée du management opérationnel, de la RWD et de l’amélioration de processus.

Ce que tu feras chez nous

Ta première mission sera de reprendre le pilotage de la production des cohortes afin d’en améliorer simultanément la qualité, la capacité de traitement et le niveau d’automatisation.

Concrètement, tu seras amené·e à :

  • Manager et faire grandir l’équipe Clinical Ops, en donnant un cadre clair aux priorités et en organisant l’activité quotidienne.

  • Anticiper la charge et piloter la capacité de production afin de limiter les bottlenecks et de mieux absorber les variations de volume.

  • Construire les outils de pilotage nécessaires pour avoir une vision fine du flux : volumes de patients, capacité de traitement, taux d’erreur, points de blocage et charge de l’équipe.

  • Construire et orchestrer une roadmap d’amélioration continue permettant progressivement d’augmenter la capacité de traitement.

  • Porter cette roadmap auprès des équipes Produit, IA et Engineering : rendre les besoins opérationnels visibles, suivre les livrables R&D et créer le rythme nécessaire pour que les améliorations soient effectivement délivrées.

  • Garantir la qualité des cohortes et contribuer à la préparation des exports de données nécessaires aux projets de recherche.

Ce que nous attendrons de toi

Dans les premiers mois, nous attendrons de toi que tu développes une compréhension très fine du flux Clinical Ops : où se trouvent les blocages, comment évolue la charge et quels leviers permettent réellement d'améliorer la production.

Ton succès se mesurera notamment à ta capacité à mettre en place un pilotage fiable de l’activité, à réduire les erreurs et les bottlenecks et à créer, avec les équipes Produit et R&D, un rythme d’amélioration continue suffisamment soutenu pour accompagner notre changement d’échelle.

À horizon 9 mois, l’objectif est clair : passer d’environ 100–200 à 300–600 cas patients structurés par semaine, sans multiplier les ressources par trois.

Ce que nous recherchons

Must-have

Nous chercherons en priorité trois éléments dans ton parcours :

  • Une expérience réussie en startup ou scale-up, dans un environnement où les process, outils et responsabilités restaient à construire.

  • Une expérience concrète de la Real-World Data / Real-World Evidence, idéalement autour de la constitution ou de l'exploitation de cohortes patients.

  • Un background santé ou scientifique te permettant de comprendre les enjeux liés aux données médicales et à la recherche clinique.

Nous attendons également :

  • Une expérience confirmée de management d’équipe opérationnelle.

  • Une expérience de structuration et de pilotage d’une activité complexe à partir de données et de KPI.

  • Une capacité à passer d’un problème opérationnel très concret à un plan d’amélioration structuré.

  • Une expérience de collaboration étroite avec des équipes Produit, Data/IA ou Engineering.

  • Une capacité à faire avancer une roadmap transverse et à créer de l’accountability autour des livrables.

Nice-to-have

  • Un parcours en data management, biostatistiques, épidémiologie ou dans un domaine scientifique proche.

  • Une expérience de structuration de registres, bases de données de santé ou cohortes RWD.

  • Une familiarité avec les enjeux de recherche clinique et les interactions avec les autorités de santé.

  • Une bonne compréhension des usages de l’IA et de l’ingénierie appliqués aux données de santé.

Ta manière de travailler

Tu as une vraie “just do it mentality” : face à un problème imparfaitement cadré, tu commences par comprendre les faits, tu structures le problème et tu mets rapidement en place les premières solutions.

Tu es particulièrement à l’aise dans les environnements où il faut créer les outils plutôt que simplement les utiliser. Si le dashboard dont tu as besoin pour piloter ton équipe n’existe pas, tu es capable de le définir et de le mettre en place.

Tu es structuré·e et organisé·e, mais pas bureaucratique. Tu sais entrer suffisamment dans le détail du flux pour comprendre les problèmes réels, tout en gardant une vision d’ensemble et en priorisant ce qui aura le plus d’impact.

Enfin, tu sais faire avancer des équipes sur lesquelles tu n’as pas nécessairement d’autorité hiérarchique. Tu rends les problèmes visibles, explicites les priorités et crées le rythme nécessaire pour transformer les décisions en améliorations concrètes.

Nos valeurs

Embrace Complexity — Tu aimes comprendre un flux de données complexe, en identifier les points de rupture et transformer cette complexité en décisions concrètes.

Bienveillance — Tu accompagnes une équipe au quotidien avec exigence, écoute et clarté.

Real Impact — Tu améliores la qualité et la disponibilité des données qui permettent de faire avancer des projets de recherche clinique.

Process de recrutement

Échange de préqualification avec Laura, Talent Acquisition Manager, 30 minutes. Nous faisons connaissance, revenons sur ton parcours, tes attentes et les grandes lignes du poste. C’est aussi le moment de répondre à tes premières questions sur Lifen, l’équipe et le contexte.

Entretien avec le VP Reasearch, 60 minutes. Nous revenons plus en détail sur ton parcours, ton expérience en RWD et en constitution de cohortes, ainsi que sur ton expérience de management et de pilotage d’activités opérationnelles. L’objectif est aussi de comprendre la manière dont tu structures et fais évoluer une organisation dans un environnement en croissance.

Use Case avec des membres des équipes Clinical Ops et Produit, 60 minutes. À partir de situations concrètes, nous échangeons sur ta manière de structurer une cohorte RWD, d’analyser des problématiques opérationnelles et de construire des plans d’amélioration. Ce sera également l’occasion d’aborder la manière dont tu gères les enjeux humains et la collaboration avec des équipes transverses.

Cultural alignment avec deux membres de Lifen, 45 minutes en visio. Ce temps permettra d’échanger sur ta façon de travailler, ton niveau d’autonomie, la collaboration au quotidien et l’adéquation avec nos valeurs.
